items.title: Notícia sobre viagem de Flávio aos EUA é anterior às eleições
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Uma notícia da emissora TVT sobre uma viagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aos Estados Unidos é de maio, mas posts têm compartilhado o conteúdo fora de contexto para insinuar que ele deixou o país após perder a eleição deste domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
items.body:
Uma notícia da emissora TVT sobre uma viagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aos Estados Unidos é de maio, mas posts têm compartilhado o conteúdo fora de contexto para insinuar que ele deixou o país após perder a eleição deste domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
"Após a intensa disputa eleitoral deste domingo, uma pergunta chama a atenção: Flávio Bolsonaro já embarcou para os Estados Unidos e não concedeu entrevistas?", diz a legenda de uma postagem no Instagram , que reproduz o vídeo sem informar que é antigo.
A TVT exibiu a notícia exibida nos posts em 25 de maio deste ano, na véspera de um encontro de Flávio com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, na Casa Branca.
No fim da tarde desta segunda-feira, o senador publicou um vídeo dizendo que pela manhã foi visitar seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que está em prisão domiciliar em Brasília e foi intimado por agentes da Polícia Federal a entregar seu passaporte.
"Eu nunca pensei em sair do país. Eu vou entregar os meus passaportes", disse Flávio.
Em setembro , a Reuters já havia desmentido posts que usavam o mesmo vídeo da TVT para alegar que o senador havia ido para os EUA após o levantamento de sigilos de investigações sobre o Banco Master.
VEREDICTO Enganoso. A notícia da TVT antecede o segundo turno das eleições. Por enquanto, não há registros de que Flávio tenha viajado aos EUA após o pleito.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro dice que la Policía Federal de Brasil le pidió su pasaporte
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro dijo el lunes que la policía federal del país le había solicitado que entregara su pasaporte tras visitar a su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, que se encuentra en prisión.
items.body:
El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro dijo el lunes que la policía federal del país le había solicitado que entregara su pasaporte tras visitar a su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, que se encuentra en prisión.
El senador, que fue derrotado el domingo por el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en la segunda vuelta, dijo que tenía intención de cumplir con la petición y negó que haya previsto huir del país tras las elecciones.

items.title: Kyiv under attack, mayor says strike near underground station
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Ukrainian capital Kyiv was under missile attack from Russian forces on Monday and the city's mayor said there had been a strike next to an underground station.
items.body:
The Ukrainian capital Kyiv was under missile attack from Russian forces on Monday and the city's mayor said there had been a strike next to an underground station.
Mayor Vitali Klitschko also said an emergency crew had come under attack and there were some injuries.
Pictures posted online on unofficial Telegram channels showed damage at an underground station. Other posts said energy infrastructure sites had come under attack.
Reuters witnesses said a series of explosions had jolted the city. They said power had been cut in districts on the east side of the Dnipro River.

items.title: Leinster's Furlong cited over alleged genital grabbing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match at the weekend.
items.body:
Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match at the weekend.
Coombes alleged during the game on Saturday that his testicles had been grabbed, but an immediate television review ordered by referee Andrew Brace was inconclusive, with no evidence of the incident.
However, since the incident was noted in the referee's report, it can be reviewed by the citing commissioner Peter Ferguson.
"Leinster Rugby's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for an incident that occurred in the 37th minute of the United Rugby Championship Round 4 fixture at the Aviva Stadium against Munster Rugby on Saturday, 24 October," a statement from the URC said on Monday.
"The Citing Commissioner in charge has made a complaint about an act of foul play by the Player (Tadhg Furlong No. 3) against opponent Gavin Coombes (No. 8).
"The Player has been cited under Law 9.27 – A player must not do anything that is against the spirit of good sportsmanship, including but not limited to grabbing, twisting or squeezing the genitals.
"Arrangements for the disciplinary process are currently in progress and will be announced in due course."
Coombes has been backed in his allegation by Munster coach Clayton McMillan.
"All I know is that I back our players 100% – that if they make an allegation like that, they wouldn't do it lightly – and that's not the sort of person Gavin is, so we'll see where that goes," McMillan said.
Furlong faces the possibility of a lengthy ban if found guilty. The 33-year-old is a British & Irish Lion and key member of the Ireland team, approaching 100 test caps. He is in the squad for November's Nations Championship fixtures, and a ban would be a blow to his personal reputation as well as to the Irish team.
Leinster head coach Leo Cullen said: "Obviously, once that accusation is made, it becomes a serious matter for the citing commissioner. So my comment is not going to help in any way here. But from what I've seen, I can't see anything."
In the URC last season, Bulls hooker Jan-Hendrik Wessels was handed a nine-week suspension for grabbing the testicles of Connacht's Josh Murphy.

items.title: Ações fecham em alta, com pedido de IPO da Anthropic impulsionando papéis do setor de IA
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: As ações nos EUA fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, com o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq saindo de quedas semanais consecutivas, já que o pedido de abertura de capital da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar o otimismo em relação aos papéis ligados à IA, em uma semana repleta de diversos catalisadores de mercado.
items.body:
As ações nos EUA fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, com o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq saindo de quedas semanais consecutivas, já que o pedido de abertura de capital da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar o otimismo em relação aos papéis ligados à IA, em uma semana repleta de diversos catalisadores de mercado.
A Anthropic divulgou perdas acentuadas e um crescimento vertiginoso da receita em seu pedido de oferta pública inicial nos EUA, expondo sua ambição de construir sistemas de IA capazes de remodelar a economia global, apesar dos altos custos de desenvolvimento da tecnologia.
O laboratório de IA segue em frente com seus planos de abertura de capital, mesmo com a desaceleração do calendário de IPOs do outono — antes bastante movimentado —, já que a recente volatilidade do mercado levou as empresas a adiar suas ofertas.
O pedido da Anthropic surge em um momento em que os investidores analisam cada vez mais o retorno potencial dos gastos maciços com IA e no início de uma semana agitada. Estão previstos a declaração de política monetária do Federal Reserve na quarta-feira, dados sobre crescimento econômico e inflação na quinta-feira e uma série de relatórios de resultados corporativos ao longo da semana.
De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) subiu 0,70%, fechando em 7.677,03 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avançou 0,83%, para 26.169,38 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve alta de 0,28%, para 52.361,76 pontos.

items.title: Confianza en el Gobierno de Milei mejora en octubre pero se mantiene cerca de los mínimos de la gestión
items.author: Tomás Carrió
items.summary: El Índice de Confianza que mide la Universidad Torcuato Di Tella trepó en el décimo mes del año, recuperando apenas una fracción de la caída del mes anterior.
items.body: Buenos Aires — La confianza en el gobierno de Javier Milei mejoró en octubre pero se mantuvo apenas por encima del piso que tocó durante la actual gestión. El Índice de Confianza en el Gobierno (ICG) que mide la Universidad Di Tella trepó 0,9% en el décimo mes del año para situarse en 1,95 puntos. Así, el indicador que se mide en una escala de 0 a 5 se ubicó apenas por encima del mínimo de 1,94 unidades al que había vuelto a caer el mes anterior. VER MÁS: Confianza en el gobierno de Milei se hunde en septiembre y vuelve al piso de su gestión Pese a ello, el nivel de confianza en el mes 34 de la presidencia de Milei es 10,9% mayor que el de la presidencia de Mauricio Macri, y 52,5% mayor que el de la de Alberto Fernández, en el mismo mes de gestión. Con esta mejora, tercera mensual de 2026, el ICG extendió la racha de altibajos que viene exhibiendo desde junio, mes en el que cortó la secuencia de seis caídas consecutivas que había encadenado entre diciembre de 2025 y mayo de este año. Desde entonces, alterna subas y caídas que lo sostienen en la zona de entre 1,94 y 2,07 puntos. La comparación con los gobiernos anteriores muestra que, en el mes 34 de mandato, Milei registra un nivel de confianza inferior al de Néstor Kirchner, que alcanzaba 2,70 puntos en el mismo momento de su presidencia. Sin embargo, el indicador actual supera los registros que tenían Mauricio Macri (1,76 puntos), Cristina Fernández de Kirchner durante su primer mandato (1,70) y segundo mandato (1,65), y Alberto Fernández (1,28). En cuanto al promedio acumulado hasta el mismo momento de cada gestión, Milei con 2,33 puntos se ubica por debajo de Macri, que registraba 2,45 puntos, pero por encima de Alberto Fernández, con 1,85. De los cinco componentes que integran el indicador, cuatro registraron mejoras mensuales, mientras que uno retrocedió. VER MÁS: Leve repunte en la aprobación e imagen de Milei, según una encuesta clave El informe también muestra una marcada relación entre las expectativas económicas y la confianza en el Gobierno. Entre quienes consideran que la situación económica mejorará dentro de un año, el ICG alcanza los 4,10 puntos, muy por encima del promedio general. En cambio, entre quienes creen que la economía empeorará, el indicador se reduce a apenas 0,40 puntos. Para aquellos que esperan que la situación se mantenga sin cambios, el índice se ubica en 2,58 puntos. El relevamiento también muestra diferencias según el nivel educativo: la confianza alcanza los 2,07 puntos entre quienes tienen estudios terciarios o universitarios, desciende a 1,84 entre quienes completaron el secundario y llega a 1,29 entre las personas con instrucción primaria.

items.title: アンソロピック、ＡＩ大事故への保険対応に警告　「引受能力不足も」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mia MacGregor

[２６日] -
items.body:
Mia MacGregor

[２６日] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックは２６日、ＡＩに関わる破滅的な事態が発生した場合、単独の保険会社の引き受け能力や専門知識を超える賠償責任が生じ、場合によっては保険業界全体でも対応しきれない恐れがあると警告した。

同社は２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開した。その書類の中で、ＡＩを巡る法理論が依然定まっていない中、自社モデルに関連する損害によって賠償責任や訴訟、規制当局の措置にさらされる可能性があると説明した。

アンソロピックは「われわれのＡＩモデルに関連する損害は、第三者による悪用から生じるものであれ、モデル自体の挙動によるものであれ、リスクの高い場面や機微な状況での利用によるものであれ、賠償責任や訴訟、規制当局の措置にわれわれをさらす可能性がある」とした。

同社は、契約上の保護措置や保険による補償が、利用者や開発者が意図しないモデルの挙動に起因するものを含め、損害賠償請求から十分に自社を守れない可能性があると述べた。

アンソロピックは、単一の事案、あるいは一連の事案が、不均衡なほど大きな損害と多額の賠償責任を引き起こす恐れがあると指摘。ＡＩに特化した保険市場はなお初期段階にあり、商業的に妥当な条件で補償を得る能力が制約される、あるいは全く得られない可能性があるとした。

同社は「破滅的なＡＩ関連事案から生じ得る損害の規模を踏まえると、いかなる単独の保険会社も、場合によっては保険業界全体を合わせても、そうしたリスクに見合う保険を引き受けるのに十分な能力や専門知識を持ち合わせていない恐れがある」と述べた。

＜サイバー保険・Ｄ＆Ｏ保険への懸念＞

アンソロピックは、サイバー保険に関するリスクにも言及した。同社はセキュリティー侵害などの事案による一定の損失を補償し得る保険に加入しているものの、保険市場が変化する中で補償が不十分になったり、利用できなくなったりする可能性があるとした。

アンソロピックは「さらに、現に加入している保険による補償が潜在的な損失を償うのに十分である保証や、提出した保険金請求が補償対象となり、保険会社によって適時に、あるいはそもそも支払われる保証はない」と述べた。

同社はまた、法律や規制、コーポレートガバナンス（企業統治）に関する開示基準の変化が、コンプライアンスコストを押し上げ、役員賠償責任（Ｄ＆Ｏ）保険をより高額にする可能性があるとも指摘した。

同社は「こうした規則や規制により、役員賠償責任保険の取得コストが上昇すると見込んでいる。補償限度額や補償範囲の縮小を受け入れざるを得なくなるか、同等の補償を維持するために大幅に高いコストを負担することになる可能性がある」とした。

items.title: Petróleo fecha em queda com esperanças de paz; ataques à Arábia Saudita limitam perdas
items.author: Siddharth Cavale
items.creator: Siddharth Cavale
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam em queda nesta segunda-feira, em meio a esperanças de uma redução das hostilidades no Oriente Médio; no entanto, os ataques persistentes à Arábia Saudita — um dos principais produtores — e ao transporte marítimo mantiveram os investidores cautelosos, com os preços oscilando próximos às máximas dos últimos seis meses.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam em queda nesta segunda-feira, em meio a esperanças de uma redução das hostilidades no Oriente Médio; no entanto, os ataques persistentes à Arábia Saudita — um dos principais produtores — e ao transporte marítimo mantiveram os investidores cautelosos, com os preços oscilando próximos às máximas dos últimos seis meses.
O Brent encerrou o dia com queda de 0,8%, a US$115,81 o barril, enquanto os contratos futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fecharam com queda de US$1,51, ou 1,46%, a US$101,76 o barril.
Ambos os índices de referência recuaram após fortes ganhos na sexta-feira, quando o Brent fechou com alta de mais de US$3, registrando um ganho semanal de 6%, enquanto o WTI subiu 2,3% na semana.
O foco dos investidores permaneceu nas tensões no Oriente Médio depois que os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, afirmaram ter atacado estações de bombeamento no oleoduto leste-oeste da Arábia Saudita e no aeroporto de Riade no fim de semana. Não houve confirmação imediata da Arábia Saudita sobre os ataques houthis.
A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita no Iêmen, no entanto, informou nesta segunda-feira que havia destruído três drones que tinham como alvo Riade e as regiões do sul do reino.
As esperanças de um avanço diplomático no conflito do Oriente Médio — que começou com ataques dos Estados Unidos e de Israel ao Irã e posteriormente se espalhou para a Arábia Saudita e o Iêmen — pesaram sobre os preços do petróleo no início do pregão, com o Brent caindo mais de US$2 por barril.
Mediadores do Catar viajaram para Teerã no domingo, em coordenação com os Estados Unidos, para buscar maneiras de amenizar as tensões regionais, segundo uma autoridade a par do assunto.
A Arábia Saudita, a Turquia e o Paquistão mantiveram conversações com autoridades iranianas em Teerã nesta segunda-feira, como parte dos esforços para evitar uma nova escalada na região.
As negociações representaram o primeiro contato de alto nível entre o Irã e as três nações, que assinaram um pacto de defesa mútua em agosto.
Ao final, os quatro países concordaram em continuar as negociações com o objetivo de fortalecer a cooperação em prol da paz e da segurança, informou a mídia estatal iraniana.
O Parlamento egípcio autorizou o presidente Abdel Fattah al-Sisi a tomar “todas as medidas necessárias” para ajudar a Arábia Saudita a se defender, aumentando a possibilidade de apoio militar egípcio ao reino.

items.title: Ibovespa fecha com maior queda desde 2020 em pregão com "circuit breaker" após reeleição de Lula
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Ibovespa fechou com a maior queda desde 2020 nesta segunda-feira, marcada por "circuit breaker" na bolsa paulista, em meio a uma forte reprecificação das ações brasileiras após o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conquistar a reeleição no domingo.
items.body:
O Ibovespa fechou com a maior queda desde 2020 nesta segunda-feira, marcada por "circuit breaker" na bolsa paulista, em meio a uma forte reprecificação das ações brasileiras após o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conquistar a reeleição no domingo.
Investidores vinham se posicionado para uma vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no segundo turno da disputa, principalmente após ele liderar a primeira etapa da disputa, vislumbrando um governo mais favorável ao mercado e melhora do cenário fiscal.
Mas, no domingo, Lula [USN:L6N46C00S TEXT:"venceu"] Flávio por 51,79% a 48,21% dos votos válidos, uma diferença de 4,4 milhões de votos, frustrando tais expectativas e desencadeando uma forte correção no mercado financeiro brasileiro como um todo.
Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) despencou 13,43%, a 177.539,81 pontos, de acordo com dados preliminares, maior perda percentual desde março de 2020, período marcado pela pandemia de Covid.
No pior momento, o Ibovespa apurou queda de mais de 17%, a 169.516,43 pontos.
O volume financeiro no pregão marcava R$109,24 bilhões antes dos ajustes finais.

items.title: Rubio dice que es necesario renovar infraestructura electoral de Venezuela antes de sufragios
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el lunes que la infraestructura electoral de Venezuela estaba diseñada para amañar las elecciones y que, por lo tanto, debía sustituirse rápidamente antes de que pueda haber una elección válida.
items.body:
El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el lunes que la infraestructura electoral de Venezuela estaba diseñada para amañar las elecciones y que, por lo tanto, debía sustituirse rápidamente antes de que pueda haber una elección válida.
Rubio habló con periodistas por teléfono un día después de que la líder de la oposición, María Corina Machado, regresó a Venezuela por primera vez desde que Estados Unidos capturó en enero al entonces presidente del país, Nicolás Maduro, y lo llevó a Nueva York para ser juzgado.
Estados Unidos cree que las conversaciones entre el Gobierno interino de Caracas y los políticos de la oposición darán lugar a la creación de un nuevo Tribunal Supremo de Justicia a finales de este año y de un nuevo Consejo Electoral poco después, había dicho antes un alto funcionario del Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos.
"Creo que estamos logrando avances reales en ese sentido", dijo Rubio. "Pero si alguien intenta descarrilar el proceso, estará causando un gran daño a Venezuela".
El Gobierno de Maduro estableció la infraestructura electoral del país para amañar las elecciones, por lo que debe cambiarse rápidamente, añadió Rubio.

items.title: Neil Young sues Trump again over 'Rockin' In The Free World'
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: Rock star Neil Young sued a group associated with President Donald Trump for copyright infringement in Virginia federal court on Monday over the president's alleged misuse of his song "Rockin' in the Free World" at an October rally.
items.body:
Rock star Neil Young sued a group associated with President Donald Trump for copyright infringement in Virginia federal court on Monday over the president's alleged misuse of his song "Rockin' in the Free World" at an October rally.
Young said in the complaint against the Trump 47 Committee that his 1989 song was played without a license before Trump took the stage at a rally in Youngstown, Ohio, in support of Republican midterm election candidates on October 12
"The lyrics paint vivid street-level portraits -- a mother discarding her baby, addicts lost in despair, garbage piling in the shadows of prosperity -- while the repeated chorus delivers a savage irony, celebrating freedom that clearly isn't shared at all," the complaint said. "In short, the song is the opposite of everything Donald J. Trump stands for."
Spokespeople for the White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the complaint
Young [USN:KCN250300 TEXT:"previously sued"] the Trump campaign in 2020 for using "Rockin' in the Free World" and another Young song at campaign rallies without permission
According to the complaint, the campaign promised never to use "Rockin' in the Free World" again without a license after [USN:L1N2IN2SH TEXT:"settling"] the case later that year
Young asked the Virginia court on Monday for $10 million in damages
The case is Young v. Trump 47 Committee Inc, US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, No. 3:26-cv-01398
For Young: Robert Besser of the Law Offices of Robert Besser
For the organization: attorney information not yet available
Read more:
[USN:KCN250300 TEXT:"Neil Young sues Donald Trump's campaign for using his songs"]
[USN:L1N2IN2SH TEXT:"Neil Young ends lawsuit against Donald Trump's campaign over use of his songs"]

items.title: Shane Steichen keeping Daniel Jones as Colts' starting QB
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Colts coach Shane Steichen once again told reporters Monday that Daniel Jones will remain Indianapolis' quarterback for the team's game at Jacksonville this week.
items.body:
Colts coach Shane Steichen once again told reporters Monday that Daniel Jones will remain Indianapolis' quarterback for the team's game at Jacksonville this week.
Steichen said after the Colts' 16-10 loss to Minnesota on Sunday to fall to 2-5 that he had previously given no consideration to a change at QB.
"He knows he's got to play better," Steichen told reporters Monday. "He's proven that he can do it. So that's where the confidence comes from. And we need to get him back playing to that level that he was last year. It's taking a little bit longer."
Jones completed 68% of his passes for 3,101 yards, 19 touchdowns and eight interceptions in 13 games last season, his first with the Colts, before tearing his Achilles.
This season, he's completing a career-low 59.6% of his passes for 1,398 yards with four touchdowns and seven interceptions -- one off the NFL lead. He has one TD and four interceptions in Indianapolis' last four games.
Jones, 29, was the sixth overall pick in the 2019 NFL Draft. He's thrown for 19,081 yards, 93 TDs and 62 picks over 90 career games for the Giants (2019-24) and Colts.
Anthony Richardson Sr., Indianapolis' fourth overall pick in the 2023 draft, is the team's backup QB. He's appeared in 17 games (15 starts) and completed 50.6% of his passes for 2,400 yards, 11 touchdowns and 13 interceptions.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US judge won't block Eli Lilly ads for weight-loss drugs, rules against Novo Nordisk
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: A US judge on Monday rejected Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly from continuing weight-loss drug advertisements that the Danish drugmaker considered false and misleading.
items.body:
A US judge on Monday rejected Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) request to block Eli Lilly (LLY.N) from continuing weight-loss drug advertisements that the Danish drugmaker considered false and misleading.
Novo Nordisk had requested a preliminary injunction to halt Eli Lilly's advertising while the case proceeded.
US District Judge Zahid Quraishi in Trenton, New Jersey rejected that request, calling Novo Nordisk's claim of irreparable harm "inadequate to warrant the extraordinary relief it seeks."
Weight-loss drugs have become major businesses for large pharmaceutical companies. The United States is one of only a handful of countries that allow direct-to-consumer advertising of prescription medicines.
Novo Nordisk [USN:L1N43N0EQ TEXT:"sued"] Eli Lilly in July, saying ads for the obesity drug Zepbound and diabetes treatment Mounjaro compared higher doses of those products with lower doses of Novo Nordisk's Wegovy and Ozempic.
The ads claiming that Eli Lilly drugs were superior violated false advertising and unfair competition laws, justifying an [USN:L8N43Q0KR TEXT:"injunction"], Novo Nordisk said.
Eli Lilly has denied wrongdoing.
Novo Nordisk is working to regain market share in the United States for its injectable obesity drugs, a market projected to exceed $100 billion by the end of the decade.
Quraishi ruled following a hearing on August 27 and 28.

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: US President Donald Trump told reporters on Monday, without citing evidence, that the Brazilian election, which leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won on Sunday, looked like it had been rigged.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump told reporters on Monday, without citing evidence, that the Brazilian election, which leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won on Sunday, looked like it had been rigged.
"I didn't take sides, but it looked like another rigged election," he said. "Elections have to be indisputable, and it looked very bad to me."
Defeated right-wing Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has [USN:L6N46C02Y TEXT:"refused to concede"] defeat.
His father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, was a close ally of Trump's while in office.
A wave of recent right-wing election victories in other Latin American countries has been heralded by Trump's administration.

items.title: Rubio says Venezuela's electoral infrastructure must be replaced before a vote
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday that Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held.
items.body:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday that Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held.
Rubio spoke to reporters by phone a day after opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returned to Venezuela for the first time since the US captured he country's then President Nicolas Maduro in January and took him to New York for trial.
The US believes that talks currently underway between the interim government in Caracas and opposition politicians will see a new supreme judicial tribunal in place by the end of this year and a new electoral council shortly thereafter, a senior US State Department official said earlier.
"I think we're making real progress in that regard," Rubio said. "But if anybody tries to derail that process, they're doing a great harm to Venezuela."
Maduro's government had set up the country's electoral infrastructure to rig elections so must be quickly changed, Rubio added.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン ２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の２期目における給油所のガソリン・軽油（ディーゼル）の平均価格は、民主党のバイデン前大統領の政権時を上回っていることが米自動車協会（ＡＡＡ）のデータから明らかになった。

１１月３日の中間選挙で共和党が上下両院で僅差の過半数維持を目指す中、燃料価格の高騰はトランプ氏にとって大きな悩みの種となっている。 

ＡＡＡのデータによると、トランプ氏が約２年前に就任して以降、レギュラーガソリンの平均価格は１ガロン当たり３．４７２ドルと、バイデン政権時の平均３．４７１ドルをわずかに上回った。

農業や重工業から運輸まで世界経済を動かす燃料である軽油の価格も、トランプ政権下で１ガロン当たり４．３４３ドルと、バイデン政権時の４．０７８ドルを上回った。米国の軽油価格は、ウクライナとイランの戦争が世界の燃料供給を混乱させる中、９月２２日に１ガロン当たり６．５２３ドルと過去最高を付けた。

ホワイトハウスはコメントの要請に対し、直ちには回答しなかった。

items.title: Ben & Jerry's explores deal with KKR executive to separate ice cream brand from owner, WSJ reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ben & Jerry's founders are exploring a deal with an executive from KKR to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
items.body:
Ben & Jerry's founders are exploring a deal with an executive from KKR (KKR.N) to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The ice cream brand is owned by Unilever (ULVR.L) spin-off Magnum (MICCT.AS) .
KKR's global co-head of private equity, Pete Stavros, has been discussing a deal with the co-founders to carve out the business and structure under an employee stock-ownership plan, WSJ said, citing Stavros and Ben & Jerry's co founder Ben Cohen.
The structure would give rank-and-file employees stock while providing the company with tax benefits, the report added.
Magnum, KKR, and Ben and Jerry's did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

items.title: Trump afirma, sem provas, que eleição no Brasil parece ter sido manipulada
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira que a eleição brasileira, vencida no domingo pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, parece ter sido fraudada.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira que a eleição brasileira, vencida no domingo pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, parece ter sido fraudada.
"Não tomei partido, mas parecia mais uma eleição fraudulenta", disse ele a jornalistas, sem apresentar nenhuma evidência. "As eleições precisam ser incontestáveis, e isso me pareceu muito ruim."
Derrotado nas eleições de domingo, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) se recusa a reconhecer o resultado.
Seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, foi um aliado próximo de Trump enquanto esteve no cargo.
O governo Trump vinha saudando uma onda de recentes vitórias eleitorais da direita em outros países da América Latina.
Trump disse ainda nesta segunda-feira gostar de Lula e se dar bem com ele.

items.title: Brazil finance minister signals more ambitious primary surplus for next year
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazil's Finance Minister, Dario Durigan, said in an interview with local news service Broadcast on Monday that the government will pursue a higher effective primary surplus next year, although he did not specify a figure.
items.body:
Brazil's Finance Minister, Dario Durigan, said in an interview with local news service Broadcast on Monday that the government will pursue a higher effective primary surplus next year, although he did not specify a figure.
Following a [USN:L2N46C051 TEXT:"sweeping selloff"] across Brazilian markets triggered by [USN:L1N468127 TEXT:"fiscal concerns"] over the [USN:L2N46B01X TEXT:"reelection"] of leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Durigan also said the government plans to send legislation to Congress this year requiring policymakers to formally target the midpoint of the primary balance goal.
The minister said the Treasury had intervened in the government bond market on Monday by canceling scheduled debt auctions and conducting extraordinary buyback operations to "ensure rationality" in trading after a sharp jump in long-term interest rate futures triggered by the election.
"But in the short, medium and long term, we will return to discussing fiscal stability, formally pursue the midpoint of the target and raise our surplus projection for next year," Broadcast quoted Durigan as saying.
Brazil's fiscal target for next year calls for a primary surplus, excluding interest payments, of 0.5% of GDP, with a tolerance band of 0.25 percentage point on either side.
Under the fiscal framework, however, the government can exclude certain expenditures when assessing compliance, most notably part of its stock of court-ordered debt payments.
In August, the government [USN:L1N44S10B TEXT:"projected"] an effective primary surplus of 0.1% of GDP for next year. If achieved, it would be Brazil's first fiscal surplus since 2022.
Most investors and economists, however, view that pace of fiscal consolidation as too slow given the rapid growth of mandatory spending, pushing investors to demand ever-higher premiums to hold Brazilian debt.
Brazil's gross public debt, the government's main solvency indicator, is up more than 10 percentage points during Lula's current term to [USN:L1N45M0ES TEXT:"82.9%"] of GDP.

items.title: Trump offers $1 million for tipoffs that lead to voter fraud convictions
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Monday the US would give $1 million to anyone who reported voter fraud that leads to an arrest and conviction, a week before midterm elections that polls show could prove difficult for his Republican Party.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Monday the US would give $1 million to anyone who reported voter fraud that leads to an arrest and conviction, a week before midterm elections that polls show could prove difficult for his Republican Party.
BACKGROUND AND QUOTE: The Trump administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach to election oversight, for example by pressing states for voter-registration data and arguing stricter measures are needed to ensure public confidence in the vote.
Critics, including political experts as well as Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach.
"Anybody reporting Voter Fraud in the past Elections, or the upcoming 2026 Midterm Election, will be paid $1,000,000 upon the arrest and conviction of those that created the Fraud," Trump wrote on Truth Social on Monday.
Some election officials have told Reuters they are preparing for potential federal interference in midterm elections.
Trump has made false claims related to elections in the past, including not acknowledging his defeat in the 2020 elections.
His supporters [USN:L6N3OH01A TEXT:"eventually stormed the US Capitol"] on January 6, 2021, in an unsuccessful attempt to prevent congressional certification of those elections.
Republicans currently hold a narrow majority in the House of Representatives and Senate.
However, ahead of the midterm vote in which control of Congress is at stake, Trump's approval has remained low due to voter concerns about the high cost of living and rising fuel prices from the US-Israeli war on Iran .
items.raw_description: President Donald Trump said on Monday the US would give $1 million to anyone who reported voter fraud that leads to an arrest and conviction, a week before midterm elections that polls show could prove difficult for his Republican Party.

items.title: 中国アリババのＡＩ、北京のサーバーに無断でデータ送信試みる＝加コヒア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - カナダの人工知能（ＡＩ）スタートアップ、コヒアは２６日、中国のテクノロジー大手アリババ・グループのオープンウエート型ＡＩモデル「Ｑｗｅｎ」の１つが、セキュリティーテスト中に北京にあるアリババクラウドのストレージサーバーへデータを送信しようとしたと明らかにした。 

このモデルは、自らの推論過程ではそうした行為を行わないと示していたにもかかわらず、送信を試みたという。アリババは通常の営業時間外のため、直ちにコメントを得ることはできなかった。 

コヒアによると、アリババの「Ｑｗｅｎ３．８─Ｆｌａｓｈ─Ｎｅｘｔ」は、悪意あるファイルのダウンロードを検知するルールを作成するよう指示されたが、代わりに実行中のマシンの状態を調査し、北京のサーバーにテストファイルを送信しようとしたという。 

コヒアのテスト環境はインターネットに接続されておらず、この試みは阻止されたものの、開発者のノートパソコンや通常のネットワークアクセスが可能なシステム上であれば、この要求がサーバーに到達していた可能性もあると同社は指摘した。

こうした挙動はまれで、コヒアのテスト全体で１０万回の動作に１回未満の頻度でしか発生しなかったが、週に１０００万件のエージェント動作を処理するサービスであれば、最大で１００件程度の同様の試みが発生し得るという。

コヒアは、この挙動が意図的なものか、それともモデルの訓練環境から消去されずに残ったデータなどによるものかは特定できなかったと述べた。

コヒアは、企業や政府向けにＡＩモデルを「ソブリンＡＩ」として販売しており、「Ｑｗｅｎ」のように誰でもダウンロードして自前のサーバーで実行できるオープンウエート型モデルと競合している。

items.title: Early returns on Seahawks WR Rashid Shaheed's knee injury ‘positive’
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The "early returns are positive" surrounding the knee injury that Seahawks wide receiver Rashid Shaheed sustained on Sunday night, coach Mike Macdonald said in a radio interview on 93.3 KJR on Monday.
items.body:
The "early returns are positive" surrounding the knee injury that Seahawks wide receiver Rashid Shaheed sustained on Sunday night, coach Mike Macdonald said in a radio interview on 93.3 KJR on Monday.
Shaheed, 28, exited in the first half of Seattle's 20-3 win over the Kansas City Chiefs with two catches for one yard. Acquired from New Orleans at the trade deadline last season, Shaheed has 16 catches for 163 yards, 39 rushing yards and one score and has averaged 27.3 yards per kick return and 11.5 yards per punt return this season.
It remains to be seen if that timeline means he could be available for Seattle's next game at the Chicago Bears on Monday, Nov. 2.
The news is reportedly a bit worse for left tackle Charles Cross, who is expected to miss time with a high ankle sprain he sustained Sunday night, per an NFL Network report.
The report indicated that the Seahawks hope the 25-year-old Cross, who has started 69 games since Seattle took him ninth overall in the 2022 NFL Draft, will be able to return in one or two weeks.
Macdonald also shared that running back Jadarian Price will have his 21-day window to return from injured reserve opened this week. Price, a first-round pick (32nd overall) in this year's draft, had 119 rushing yards in Seattle's first three games before missing the last four games on IR with a chest injury.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cemex supera expectativas en el tercer trimestre impulsado por México
items.author: Valentine Hilaire
items.summary: México fue un motor para los resultados de la cementera, mientras Estados Unidos sigue representando un desafío.
items.body: Bloomberg — Los resultados financieros de Cemex SAB ( CEMEXCPO ) superaron las expectativas, ya que la recuperación en México y las medidas de reducción de costos permitieron a la mayor cementera del país compensar la debilidad en el mercado estadounidense. El flujo operativo (EBITDA) aumentó un 12%, alcanzando los US$990 millones en el tercer trimestre, cifra que superó el promedio de las estimaciones de los analistas recopiladas por Bloomberg. Tanto los ingresos como las ganancias netas superaron las previsiones. México fue un motor clave de este desempeño: el volumen de ventas de cemento creció un 7% y los precios aumentaron un 5% en pesos. Estos avances refuerzan las señales de recuperación en el mercado local de Cemex, tras la mejora tanto en los volúmenes como en los precios registrada en el trimestre anterior. El mercado estadounidense sigue representando un desafío. Aunque los volúmenes de cemento y agregados aumentaron durante el trimestre, los resultados se vieron afectados por una interrupción no planificada, una mayor inflación en los costos de las materias primas para ciertos productos y una caída en los precios del cemento. Cemex tiene como objetivo lograr un ahorro recurrente de costos de US$475 millones para 2027, y prevé un crecimiento de su EBITDA de entre el 16% y el 17% para este año. Las acciones cayeron un 1,2%, situándose en MXN$18,84 a las 8:06 a. m. (hora de la Ciudad de México), mientras que el índice de referencia del país registró un descenso del 0,83%.
items.raw_description: México fue un motor para los resultados de la cementera, mientras Estados Unidos sigue representando un desafío.

items.title: Victoria de Lula frustra la venta de acciones por US$6.000 millones en Brasil, según fuentes
items.author: Rachel Gamarski, Cristiane Lucchesi, Leda Alvim
items.summary: Empresas brasileñas tenían previstas ventas de acciones tras las elecciones, pero ahora esos planes se han visto trastocados tras la inesperada victoria de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
items.body: Bloomberg — Las empresas brasileñas tenían previstas ventas de acciones por valor de unos US$6.000 millones para las semanas posteriores a las elecciones, en las que esperaban que el conservador Flávio Bolsonaro resultara elegido próximo presidente de la mayor economía de América Latina. Ver más: El nuevo equipo económico de Lula determinará hasta dónde puede caer la bolsa de Brasil, según BTG Ahora, tras la sorprendente derrota del presidente en funciones, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, esos planes se han visto comprometidos por empresas de sectores que van desde el transporte de energía hasta las autopistas y el comercio minorista, según personas al tanto de las conversaciones. Los mercados brasileños se desploman tras las elecciones, con las acciones registrando la mayor caída en 30 años y el real, la mayor desde 1999. Los banqueros de inversión habían estimado que solo las ofertas públicas de venta de acciones podrían recaudar unos 30.000 millones de reales (US$6.000 millones) en los próximos seis meses bajo un gobierno de Bolsonaro, según conversaciones privadas mantenidas en Faria Lima, en São Paulo, el equivalente brasileño de Wall Street. La idea era que las promesas de un clima empresarial más favorable bajo el mandato del candidato opositor reforzarían las valoraciones bursátiles, lo que convertiría este momento en uno atractivo para que las empresas brasileñas captaran capital. Varias empresas estaban preparando ventas de acciones que podrían haberse lanzado ya hoy mismo, según indicaron estas fuentes, que pidieron no ser identificadas al referirse a conversaciones privadas. Ahora, los banqueros no esperan ninguna venta hasta mediados de 2027. Entre las empresas que habían estado barajando la posibilidad de recurrir al mercado de valores se encontraban la empresa de suministro eléctrico Equatorial SA y la operadora de autopistas de peaje Ecorodovias Infraestrutura e Logística SA. La empresa de gas Compass Gas e Energia SA, la minorista Guararapes Confecções SA y la empresa de transmisión de energía Transmissora Aliança de Energia Elétrica SA también habían estado sopesando nuevas ofertas de venta de acciones, según indicaron las fuentes. Los resultados también han trastocado los planes de empresas que llevan años preparándose para salir a bolsa. El Banco Votorantim SA figuraba entre aquellas que podrían haber reactivado sus planes de cotización, posiblemente a principios de 2027, mientras que Aegea Saneamento e Participações SA también estaba barajando una salida a bolsa a finales del próximo año, según indicaron las fuentes. El Banco Votorantim, Aegea, Transmissora Aliança de Energia Elétrica y Cosan se negaron a hacer comentarios. Equatorial, Ecorodovias y Guararapes no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Los ejecutivos y banqueros están reevaluando las perspectivas de las acciones brasileñas, las tasas de interés y el crecimiento económico tras la victoria de Lula. Lula, de quien los mercados consideran poco probable que impulse la austeridad fiscal necesaria para reducir las tasas de interés, obtuvo el 51,8% de los votos en la segunda vuelta. Bolsonaro obtuvo el 48,2%, según el Tribunal Electoral Federal de Brasil. Los inversores habían apostado por una victoria de Bolsonaro tras su resultado sorprendentemente sólido en la primera vuelta, lo que desencadenó un repunte y atrajo miles de millones en flujos de capital extranjero. Empresas como UBS Global Wealth Management ( UBS ), Morgan Stanley ( MS ), JPMorgan Chase & Co ( JPM ) y Citigroup Inc ( C ) se apresuraron a publicar previsiones alcistas sobre los activos brasileños. Ahora, la reevaluación se está extendiendo más allá de los mercados de capitales. También se están reconsiderando las fusiones y adquisiciones que afectan a empresas expuestas al mercado de consumo brasileño, a medida que los inversores sopesan las implicaciones de las elecciones para el crecimiento y la confianza de los consumidores, según indicaron las fuentes. Esto incluye las negociaciones de Azzas 2154 SA relativas a la venta de la cadena de moda Farm Rio, según las mismas fuentes. Azzas 2154 no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Los líderes empresariales también están centrando su atención en el equipo económico de Lula y en las perspectivas de la política fiscal. Prevén un contexto fiscal difícil, ya que ahora habrá que financiar las promesas electorales, cuyo costo se estima en más de 50.000 millones de reales, pero esperan que el presidente nombre a figuras centristas para ocupar puestos clave. Se ha mencionado al gobernador del estado de Piauí, Rafael Fonteles, como un posible candidato favorable a las empresas para el Ministerio de Hacienda, y al senador Camilo Santana para el cargo de jefe de gabinete, según las personas familiarizadas con la opinión del sector empresarial brasileño. Existe cierta preocupación por la posibilidad de que Fonteles no renuncie a su cargo de gobernador para incorporarse al Gobierno tan poco tiempo después de haber sido reelegido con más del 70% de los votos. También se ha barajado el nombre del vicepresidente Geraldo Alckmin para un cargo, aunque la comunidad empresarial no le apoya de forma unánime, según indicaron las mismas fuentes. Un responsable de la campaña de Lula no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Los ejecutivos empresariales brasileños mantuvieron una relación conflictiva con Lula durante su último mandato, y no esperan un cambio significativo para el próximo. No obstante, existe optimismo respecto a que el banco estatal de desarrollo BNDES se convierta en un socio importante para las empresas, posiblemente mediante inyecciones de liquidez similares a la realizada a principios de este año a la empresa de logística Simpar SA, según indicaron las fuentes. El mercado podría estabilizarse si Lula presenta un plan creíble para contener el gasto y nombra un equipo económico que se perciba como comprometido con la disciplina fiscal, según indicaron las fuentes. --Con la colaboración de Matheus Piovesana, Barbara Nascimento y Augusta Saraiva. items.title: EEUU espera que se renueve infraestructura electoral en Venezuela antes de que haya elecciones: funcionario
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Estados Unidos espera que Venezuela renueve su infraestructura electoral antes de que puedan celebrarse elecciones, con un nuevo tribunal supremo de justicia en funciones a finales de este año y un nuevo organismo electoral poco después, dijo el lunes un funcionario del Departamento de Estado.
items.body:
Estados Unidos espera que Venezuela renueve su infraestructura electoral antes de que puedan celebrarse elecciones, con un nuevo tribunal supremo de justicia en funciones a finales de este año y un nuevo organismo electoral poco después, dijo el lunes un funcionario del Departamento de Estado.
El funcionario, que habló con periodistas bajo condición de anonimato, señaló que Washington está colaborando con las autoridades provisionales y ejerciendo influencia para garantizar que las reformas continúen a un ritmo adecuado.

items.title: US, Canada working on deal to ease steel, auto tariffs, sources say
items.author: Promit Mukherjee, David Shepardson
items.creator: Promit Mukherjee, David Shepardson
items.summary: The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, two US and four Canadian sources said, as the two governments try to repair relations that soured after trade talks broke down in August.
items.body:
The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, two US and four Canadian sources said, as the two governments try to repair relations that soured after trade talks broke down in August.
The talks focus on tariffs imposed under Section 232 of US trade law, including up to 50% tariff on Canadian steel and a 25% tariff on autos, with negotiators discussing potential relief from those duties.
The negotiations come as US President Donald Trump faces record-low approval ratings and his Republican Party risks losing control of Congress in next week's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. Tariffs on Canadian imports have become a[USN:L6N4580Y1 TEXT:" political liability"] for Trump, with Republican candidates in border states calling for an end to the trade war with Canada.
One Canadian source briefed on the negotiations said a deal on steel and auto tariffs was possible before the November 3 elections, while US sources said the Trump administration wanted Canada to make further concessions. The sources spoke on condition of anonymity because the talks are private.
The Section 232 tariffs are administered by the Commerce Department, putting Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick rather than the US Trade Representative's office at the center of the negotiations, sources on both sides of the border said.
Lutnick and Canada’s Dominic LeBlanc, the minister responsible for Canada-U.S. trade, have been in regular contact recently, one of the sources said.
LeBlanc’s office said Canada remains in contact with Washington.
“Canada remains in constructive dialogue with our U.S. counterparts on a range of priorities,” a spokesperson for LeBlanc, said in a statement. “We stand ready to work constructively and in good faith towards a more mutually beneficial trading relationship that respects Canada’s interests.”
The White House, the Commerce Department and the USTR’s office did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
A Canadian industry source said a deal could come quickly, but not necessarily a broad one. “If it happens, it’ll happen fast. But my sense is it’ll be a narrowed deal, if it even happens,” the source said.
Another Canadian source said they have believed for some time that a deal on Section 232 tariffs is likely before the midterms. Any agreement would be driven by Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, the source said, adding that both leaders had said a mutually beneficial deal is possible.
Carney has said he wants a [USN:O8N40E02J TEXT:"good deal "]for Canada.
US and Canadian trade talks collapsed in August over issues such as whether to cut duties on medium- and heavy-duty vehicles that are critical for Canadian factories. US automakers [USN:L6N44N0VK TEXT:"had hoped"] the trade talks would deliver relief from Washington's original 25% tariffs that have raised the cost of shipping vehicles and parts across the border.
Trump has previously announced that he would raise the tariffs on steel and auto imports from Canada to 50% from January 1, 2027. At a political rally on Sunday, Trump predicted the trade dispute would be resolved "soon," without providing specifics.
Trump signed an order on Friday to remove 50% tariffs on some Canadian agricultural and forestry products in a move that could benefit businesses in Maine.

items.title: Investigación de la ONU afirma que Israel siguió cometiendo genocidio en Gaza tras la tregua
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel siguió cometiendo genocidio en Gaza tras el alto el fuego negociado por Estados Unidos el pasado mes de octubre en el enclave, afirmó una comisión de la ONU en un informe publicado el lunes que Israel desestimó como parte de una "campaña de desinformación".
items.body:
Israel siguió cometiendo genocidio en Gaza tras el alto el fuego negociado por Estados Unidos el pasado mes de octubre en el enclave, afirmó una comisión de la ONU en un informe publicado el lunes que Israel desestimó como parte de una "campaña de desinformación".
El informe de la Comisión Internacional Independiente de Investigación de la ONU sobre el Territorio Palestino Ocupado, incluida Jerusalén Este, e Israel examinó las violaciones cometidas contra los niños palestinos desde el inicio de la guerra el 7 de octubre de 2023 hasta septiembre de este año.
En él se afirma que las autoridades israelíes han seguido cometiendo "actos genocidas con la intención genocida de destruir, total o parcialmente, a los palestinos de Gaza", y que la situación también ha seguido deteriorándose en la Cisjordania ocupada.
Otro informe de la comisión, publicado en septiembre del año pasado, concluyó que Israel había cometido genocidio en Gaza y que altos cargos israelíes, entre ellos el primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, habían incitado a cometer estos actos —acusaciones que Israel calificó de escandalosas—.
La misión israelí en Ginebra afirmó que el último informe formaba parte de una campaña de desinformación destinada a demonizar al Estado de Israel.
"El intento de destruir el Estado judío (...) continúa hoy en día a través de los esfuerzos de actores como la Comisión de Investigación de la ONU para socavar la legitimidad de Israel y negarle su derecho fundamental a existir y a defenderse", declaró el embajador Daniel Meron en un comunicado.
La comisión constató que las fuerzas israelíes continuaron utilizando munición pesada, drones, cuadricópteros, artillería y fuego de francotiradores en zonas densamente pobladas durante el alto el fuego en Gaza.
Señaló que la "Línea Amarilla", que se presentó como una demarcación temporal del alto el fuego, se estaba adentrando cada vez más en Gaza y se estaba convirtiendo en una frontera de facto, lo que, según el informe, reflejaba la expansión del control territorial de Israel sobre Gaza.
Las autoridades palestinas afirman que más de 74.000 personas han perdido la vida en la ofensiva israelí contra Gaza, lanzada después de que combatientes liderados por Hamás mataran a unas 1.200 personas en el sur de Israel el 7 de octubre de 2023.
En su informe al Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, la comisión señaló que la situación en Cisjordania también se había deteriorado drásticamente, ya que el número de palestinos muertos en ataques aéreos había aumentado de seis entre 2008 y el 6 de octubre de 2023 a 254 entre el 7 de octubre de 2023 y el 30 de septiembre de 2026.
El presidente de la comisión, Srinivasan Muralidhar, afirmó que el asesinato intencionado de civiles palestinos y la destrucción de viviendas en Cisjordania formaban parte de una estrategia más amplia para exterminar y desplazar a los palestinos.
Las operaciones militares llevadas a cabo desde enero de 2025 han provocado el mayor desplazamiento de palestinos en Cisjordania desde 1967, con 34.176 palestinos que seguían desplazados en agosto de 2026, según el informe.
La comisión también criticó a la Autoridad Palestina, afirmando que había tomado como blanco a los palestinos que expresaban opiniones discrepantes y que periodistas y defensores de los derechos humanos habían resultado muertos y heridos.

items.title: Skydance offers buyouts to some employees to cut costs after Warner Bros merger
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Skydance is offering some employees a one-time voluntary buyout, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, as the media company looks to cut costs after scooping up bigger rival Warner Bros Discovery and assuming its massive debt.
items.body:
Skydance (SKYD.N) is offering some employees a one-time voluntary buyout, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, as the media company looks to cut costs after scooping up [USN:L4N45E0M9 TEXT:"bigger rival Warner Bros Discovery"] and assuming its massive debt.
The company, whose shares have fallen by about a third this year, is also moving to a five-day-a-week in-office policy, the memo showed.
"As we bring our teams together, we recognize that not everyone will see their future here, and we respect that," Skydance CEO David Ellison and co-CEO Ynon Kreiz said in the memo
The communication also said employees who qualify for the buyout program would be notified of the terms and given a window to decide whether to accept the one-time offer
Earlier this month, Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery, with the combined entity renamed Skydance
Skydance is expected to have about 53,000 employees, according to the companies' respective annual filings as of the end of last year
The company is expected to shoulder about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on management to expand streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance
The company is set to report third quarter results on November 9, where investors will be focused on its new strategy
Semafor and CNBC reported last week that Elon Musk has [USN:L4N4681ZR TEXT:"invested"] roughly $1 billion in Skydance

items.summary: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts.
items.body:
O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts.
“Urgente: Jair Bolsonaro é preso por desacato à autoridade e será enviado de volta para a Papuda”, dizem postagens que passaram a circular no Facebook e no Instagram neste, após a vitória do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sobre Flávio Bolsoanaro (PL).
O STF negou à Reuters que tenha havido uma decisão da Corte neste sentido.
A determinação também não consta no processo de execução penal do ex-presidente, que cumpre pena de mais de 27 anos de prisão por tentar dar um golpe de Estado em 2022.
A defesa do político disse por mensagem que “desconhece” uma ordem para que ele volte ao regime fechado e o alegado episódio de desacato.
Até ser enviado para a prisão domiciliar , Bolsonaro foi mantido na prisão da Papudinha, que faz parte do Complexo Penitenciário da Papuda.
Procurada, a Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal, que administra a Papudinha, não havia respondido até a publicação deste texto.
VEREDICTO Falso. O STF e a defesa de Bolsonaro negaram que ele tenha sido enviado de volta ao regime fechado após cometer desacato de autoridade.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Anthropic deve integrar grupo de maiores IPOs do mundo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Anthropic divulgou nesta segunda-feira pedido de abertura de capital nos Estados Unidos, aproximando a criadora do chatbot Claude de uma estreia histórica nos mercados acionários do país.
items.body:
A Anthropic divulgou nesta segunda-feira pedido de abertura de capital nos Estados Unidos, aproximando a criadora do chatbot Claude de uma estreia histórica nos mercados acionários do país.
O IPO deverá ser um dos maiores já realizados, com potencial para redefinir índices de referência, fluxos de investidores e a narrativa mais ampla que impulsiona as bolsas de valores dos EUA.
“Uma oferta pública inicial bem-sucedida da Anthropic poderá abrir ou fechar de vez o mercado de IPOs, mesmo já em 2027”, disse Matt Kennedy, estrategista sênior da Renaissance Capital, uma empresa especializada em pesquisas focadas em IPOs e ETFs.
MAIORES IPOS ANTHROPIC Alguns investidores atuais e potenciais estão avaliando a Anthropic em cerca de US$1,5 trilhão, abaixo dos cerca de US$2 trilhões esperados anteriormente, após a startup de IA ter divulgado alguns detalhes financeiros em um evento recente para investidores.
A oferta pública inicial já foi adiada em relação aos planos iniciais, com a Reuters informando anteriormente que a divulgação da operação deveria começar, no mínimo, em meados de outubro.
A gigante da IA busca levantar até US$100 bilhões no IPO, segundo a Reuters.
No final de maio, a Anthropic levantou US$65 bilhões, obtendo um valor de mercado de US$965 bilhões.
OPENAI A OpenAI, criadora do chatbot ChatGPT, revelou em junho que havia apresentado confidencialmente um pedido de IPO nos EUA.
A empresa não abrirá o capital em 2026, afirmou o presidente-executivo, Sam Altman, em setembro, citando preocupações com a segurança da inteligência artificial que tornam “inaceitável” até mesmo um risco de 10% de que a IA possa causar a extinção da humanidade até o final da década.
A OpenAI está correndo para garantir o compromisso dos investidores antes da esperada estreia no mercado de ações da rival Anthropic, em meados de novembro, em uma captação de recursos excepcionalmente rápida que poderá avaliar a criadora do ChatGPT em mais de US$1,4 trilhão, segundo reportagem da Reuters.
“Ainda não decidimos o momento; pode demorar um pouco, pois há coisas que queremos fazer e que provavelmente são mais fáceis como empresa privada. Mas é um conjunto complicado de 'trade-offs', e isso nos dá a opção de abrir o capital mais cedo, se essa acabar sendo a melhor opção”, afirmou a OpenAI em junho.
SPACEX A SpaceX, fabricante de foguetes e satélites de Elon Musk, fez sua estreia histórica na Nasdaq em junho, quebrando recordes e superando de longe o IPO da petrolífera Saudi Aramco em 2019, que até então tinha sido responsável pela maior oferta pública inicial de ações de todos os tempos.
O IPO da SpaceX rompeu com as tradições ao atingir o valor recorde de US$75 bilhões, afastando-se do processo normal de IPO ao definir o preço antes das reuniões com investidores durante um roadshow.
Os recursos arrecadados pela SpaceX foram mais do que o dobro dos obtidos pela Saudi Aramco em 2019.
As ações da SpaceX encerraram o primeiro dia de negociação a US$160,95 por ação, elevando seu valor para US$2,1 trilhões. Desde então, as ações perderam parte da força e fecharam a US$147,49 em 23 de outubro, 9,3% acima do preço de US$135 da oferta pública inicial.
(Por Arasu Kannagi Basil e Manya Saini)

items.title: ブラジル金融市場大荒れ、ルラ大統領再選で財政運営警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rodrigo Campos　Marcela Ayres　Karin Strohecker

[ニューヨーク／ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Rodrigo Campos　Marcela Ayres　Karin Strohecker

[ニューヨーク／ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター] - ブラジルで２５日に行われた大統領選の決選投票で、左派で現職のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り再選を果たしたことを受け、２６日のブラジル金融市場は株価とレアル相場が急落するなど大荒れの展開となった。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの中南米担当シニアエコノミスト、マウリシオ・モンヘ氏は「ルラ氏の勝利を受け、ルラ氏の４期目政権下での財政見通しを巡る見直しが市場で進み、急激な売りが広がった」と指摘。「ルラ氏にとって最大の課題は、実質賃金の上昇と雇用拡大を優先しながら、信頼性があり持続可能な財政再建の実現は可能だと市場を納得させることだ」と述べた。

ＩＮＧのストラテジスト、クリス・ターナー氏は「国内金融市場にとって重要なのは、ボルソナロ氏がどれだけ早く選挙結果を受け入れるか、少なくとも憲法に基づく手続きの進行を容認することだ」と指摘。市場はまた、ルラ氏の財務相人事にも注目。ＲＢＣブルーベイ・アセット・マネジメントのグラハム・ストック氏は「次期ルラ政権が財政規律を維持する意思を示すかが市場にとって最大の焦点になっている。その第一歩となるのが、今後数週間以内に行われる新財務相の任命だ」と述べた。

２６日の株式市場では、ブラジルの主要株価指数のボベスパ指数が一時１５％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては１９９８年以来最大の下落率となる可能性がある。ブラジル証券取引所を運営するＢ３は、ボベスパ指数が前営業日終値から１０％下落したことを受けサーキットブレーカーが発動され、株式売買を３０分間停止したと発表した。

外国為替市場では、ブラジルレアルが対ドルで一時１１％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては過去最大級になる可能性がある。

売りはブラジル国債にも波及。２０５４年償還債など超長期債を中心に大きく売られた。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのデータによると、ブラジルの５年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）保証料率は１５１．６７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）に上昇。前週末終値の１２０．２１ｂｐから大幅に拡大した。ＣＤＳは国債の債務不履行（デフォルト）に対する保険コストの指標とされる。

市場が急落する中、ブラジル財務省は２７日に予定していた物価連動国債の入札と、２９日に予定していた固定利付国債の入札を中止した。

items.author: Reuters

items.body:
El ministro de Hacienda de Brasil, Dario Durigan, dijo el lunes, en una entrevista con la agencia de noticias local Broadcast, que el Gobierno se fijará como objetivo alcanzar un superávit primario efectivo más alto el próximo año, pero no especificó ninguna cifra.
En la entrevista, tras una caída generalizada en los mercados brasileños a raíz de la reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Durigan también señaló que el Gobierno tiene previsto presentar al Congreso un proyecto que obligue a los responsables políticos a fijar formalmente como meta el punto medio del objetivo de saldo primario.

items.title: Russian sabotage network believed to have caused Romanian fire, prosecutors say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Romania's Intelligence Service said on Monday it had identified a sabotage network coordinated by Russia, which it believed was responsible for a fire in September at an industrial site in central Romania near a state-owned weapons company.
items.body:
Romania's Intelligence Service said on Monday it had identified a sabotage network coordinated by Russia, which it believed was responsible for a fire in September at an industrial site in central Romania near a state-owned weapons company.
The European Union and NATO state shares a land border of more than 600 km (370 miles) with Ukraine, and centrist president Nicusor Dan has said it is the target of a hybrid war waged by Russia to destabilise nations that support Kyiv.
The attacks range from drone incursions into Romanian airspace to cyberattacks, disinformation campaigns, acts of sabotage and attacks on cargo vessels near Romanian waters, Dan has said.
Russia's embassy in Bucharest could not immediately be reached for comment outside business hours but Moscow has repeatedly denied such accusations.
Romanian organised crime prosecutors said they were seeking the extradition of two Belarusian suspects apprehended in Germany and one Ukrainian detained in Poland who were all suspected of involvement in the arson case.
The Intelligence Service said all three were part of the network coordinated by Russia, whose coordinators had assigned it targets including "state and private weapons production facilities, as well as other objectives of military and industrial interest".
A year ago, Poland and Romania [USN:L8N3W204K TEXT:"detained"] eight people suspected of involvement in a Russian plan to send exploding parcels to Ukraine.
Dan accused Russia of [USN:L1N4690DK TEXT:"escalating"] its attacks on NATO's eastern flank this month after a series of drone strikes on cargo vessels in the Black Sea.
At least eight cargo ships have been hit off the coast of NATO members Romania and Bulgaria in the past three weeks. Some 34 sailors are reported dead or missing.

items.title: Canadiense Capstone Copper anuncia plan de inversión por 3.000 mln dlr en norte de Chile: Ministerio de Minería
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La minera canadiense Capstone Copper anunció un plan de inversión por más de 3.000 millones de dólares en la región de Atacama, en el norte de Chile, informó el lunes el bimistro de Economía y Minería del país austral, Daniel Mas.
items.body:
La minera canadiense Capstone Copper (CS.TO) anunció un plan de inversión por más de 3.000 millones de dólares en la región de Atacama, en el norte de Chile, informó el lunes el bimistro de Economía y Minería del país austral, Daniel Mas.
El plan de inversiones anunciado por la firma le permitirá duplicar su producción de cobre en Chile al año 2031, según un comunicado.
El anuncio "representa la consolidación de Chile como una potencia minera indiscutida a nivel global", aseguró Mas en el comunicado.

items.title: Canada's Capstone Copper announces $3 billion investment plan in Chile
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canadian miner Capstone Copper on Monday announced a $3 billion investment plan in Chile's Atacama region, according to Chile's mining ministry.
items.body:
Canadian miner Capstone Copper (CS.TO) on Monday announced a $3 billion investment plan in Chile's Atacama region, according to Chile's mining ministry.
The investment plan, which will allocate $2.3 billion to the Santo Domingo project and a further $220 million to two short-term projects at Mantoverde, is expected to double Capstone's copper production in the country by 2031. Construction at Santo Domingo will require more than 8,000 workers at its peak, the ministry said.

items.title: Financial transactions watchdog steps up action against money service businesses
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s financial intelligence agency revoked the registrations of 82 money service businesses in 2025-26, up from 12 the previous year.
items.body: OTTAWA — Canada’s financial intelligence agency revoked the registrations of 82 money service businesses in 2025-26, up from 12 the previous year. The Financial Transactions and Reports Analysis Centre (FINTRAC) says it focused significant resources on the money services sector in the last year due to money laundering and terrorist financing risks associated with such businesses. FINTRAC notes in its annual report that businesses which exchange foreign currencies, transfer money, cash money orders or traveller’s cheques, or deal in virtual currency must register with the centre before offering these services. Individuals convicted of certain offences are ineligible to register a money service business, meaning a registration could be denied or revoked. The report says the centre took “aggressive action” to address non-compliance in the sector, including illicit cryptocurrency activity, across Canada in the last year. In addition to rescinding registrations, Fintrac imposed administrative monetary penalties totalling more than $198 million on nine money service businesses for a variety of violations. --- Jim Bronskill, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 26, 2026.

items.summary: Jim Kessler, executive vice president for Policy at Third Way, said that the organization's polling shows that voters are moving away from Donald Trump and toward Democrats and that the upcoming midterm elections feel like not only a blue wave, but a 'blue tidal wave.' items.title: LIV Golf appoints former TaylorMade CEO Mark King as senior adviser
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: LIV Golf on Monday appointed former TaylorMade chief executive Mark King as senior advisor of the rebel circuit that will soon learn if it will move ahead with a restructured 2.0 model or wind down operations.
items.body:
[USN:L6N4601B9 TEXT:"LIV Golf"] on Monday appointed former TaylorMade chief executive Mark King as senior advisor of the rebel circuit that will soon learn if it will move ahead with a restructured 2.0 model or wind down operations.
King's role is effective immediately and comes at a critical point for LIV, which is attempting to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection with a restructured ownership model and a proposed new investment arrangement with BC Partners Credit.
LIV, which in recent weeks has seen some of its biggest names decide that they want no part of the league's uncertain future, said in a press release that King will be expected to recruit, build and serve as chairman of LIV Golf's Advisory Board for the next era of the league.
"His deep understanding and relationships in and around the professional golf industry, combined with his expertise in driving innovation and building high-performing organizations, makes him a valuable addition as an advisor to our team at this pivotal moment," LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil said in a press release.
King spent 34 years at TaylorMade, where he moved up the ranks, starting as a sales representative in the 1980s. He was named president in 1999 and CEO in 2002.
"Having spent much of my career in golf, I believe there is a tremendous opportunity for LIV Golf to establish itself as a competitive and enduring force in the game," said King.
"With a renewed business model that puts players at the centre, I see significant potential for the League to build on that foundation, and create lasting value for players, fans, and partners alike. I look forward to working with Scott and the team at LIV Golf."
According to LIV, the league is "laser focused" on advancing its conversations with players regarding their participation in 2.0 and it remains "on track" to secure the support needed to complete the recapitalisation transaction.
[USN:L6N45T131 TEXT:"Former world number one Jon Rahm"], who won three consecutive season-long individual titles on LIV since joining the circuit in late 2023, is among the big-name players who have decided not to stick with the league.
During a recent court hearing, a judge approved the amended restructuring support agreement between LIV and BC Partners, which allowed the rebel circuit to rehire staff and start planning initiatives for its next iteration.
The decision on how many players constitute a league and which players need to be included rests with BC Partners. The judge also approved the amended agreement in which BC Partners would provide as much as $300 million in financing to LIV Golf, including an initial $4 million.
BC Partners, which provides financing to middle-market companies, has said its funding would support what it described as the next phase of LIV Golf, under which players would become equity owners of both the league and its teams.
LIV Golf's next bankruptcy court hearing is scheduled for November 5.

"With a renewed business model that puts players at the centre, I see significant potential for the League to build on that foundation, and create lasting value for players, fans, and partners alike. I look forward to working with Scott and the team at LIV Golf."
According to LIV, the league is "laser focused" on advancing its conversations with players regarding their participation in 2.0 and it remains "on track" to secure the support needed to complete the recapitalisation transaction.

items.body:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

上昇して取引を終えた。幅広い銘柄に買い注文が入り、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反発。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．０９％高と続伸した。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発投資への警戒感が根強い中、米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請の動きが好感された。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は５．２８％高。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは６．１％、防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは４．１％それぞれ上昇した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは堅調な利益見通しを示し、１３．１％高。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドの３ｉグループは２．６％上昇した。

一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．８９％安。石油大手のＢＰは１．２％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

今週は、ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案発表を２８日に控える。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が開催する連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）にも注目が集まっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。堅調な企業業績見通しが相次いで発表され、投資家の期待感が相場を後押しした。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は０．９１％高。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．６４％高。旅行・娯楽関連株指数は１．９２％上昇。一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．１９％下落した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは通期利益見通しが市場予想を上回り、１３．１％上昇。大腸がん治療薬の臨床試験のデータを発表したデンマークのバイオ医薬品会社ジェンマブは１２．１％値上がりした。

ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が発表した１０月の業況指数は市場予想以上に改善した。

今週は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がそれぞれ金融政策決定会合を開く。市場では、ＥＣＢが政策金利を据え置き、１２月に利上げするとの観測が強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債の価格が５月以来最大の上昇率を記録する勢いとなった。ムーディーズによる格下げを免れたほか、週末の抗議活動もおおむね前週のような騒乱に発展せず、国債売りに歯止めがかかった。

週内に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利決定を控え、原油価格の小幅下落も一部のユーロ圏国債を支えた。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは約１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、４．９１５％となった。１日の低下幅としては５月下旬以来最大となる見通し。前週は５．１４１５％と、２４年ぶりの高水準に達していた。

独仏１０年債の利回り格差は１１ｂｐ縮小して１５５ｂｐとなった。前週には１７７．７ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。

議会の分裂で財政再建が難航し、２０２７年の大統領選に向けた駆け引きも始まる中、仏政府にとって一定の安心材料となった。しかし、ＤＺ銀行のアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は、フランス国債の重しとなっている財政問題は解消していないと指摘した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．３５％となった。

ＥＣＢの政策見通しの変化に敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇し、３．０７５％となった。

ドイツ国債は前週、安全資産への資金逃避の主な受け皿の一つとなった。

ＥＣＢの政策見通しの変化に敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇し、３．０７５％となった。

ドイツ国債は前週、安全資産への資金逃避の主な受け皿の一つとなった。

items.title: Aspen Neuroscience, Bambusa Therapeutics launch US IPOs as biotech boom rolls on
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Drug developers Aspen Neuroscience and Bambusa Therapeutics launched their US initial public offering roadshows on Monday, adding to a wave of issuers from the biotech industry that have tapped the fall IPO window.
items.body:
Drug developers Aspen Neuroscience and Bambusa Therapeutics launched their US initial public offering roadshows on Monday, adding to a wave of issuers from the biotech industry that have tapped the fall IPO window.
The sector has been a bright spot in an otherwise lackluster fall IPO window this year, as rising borrowing costs and choppy market conditions keep a lid on activity from other industries.
More than half a dozen biotech firms have gone public in New York since September. Drug developers Rezera and [USN:L4N4691PF TEXT:"Windward Bio"] also unveiled their US IPO filings last week, a key step ahead of a potential roadshow launch.
"Biotech offers investors opportunities where clinical catalysts can drive returns even when the broader economic outlook is uncertain, giving specialist investors reasons to back individual companies despite higher rates," IPOX associate Lukas Muehlbauer told Reuters.
"Strong debuts from some recent listings also helps to encourage the next group of issuers, particularly those seeking funding for upcoming trials. Still, investor appetite remains selective, as higher financing costs remain a challenge for companies that may be years away from generating revenue."
San Diego, California-based Aspen is developing therapies for neurodegenerative diseases. Its lead product candidate, sasineprocel, is in an early-to-mid-stage trial to treat Parkinson’s disease.
Boston, Massachusetts-based Bambusa is developing drugs for immunological and inflammatory disorders. Its lead product candidate, BBT001, is in early-stage development to treat a type of dermatitis and other inflammatory skin diseases.
Aspen and Bambusa are each marketing 9.38 million shares in their IPOs priced between $15 and $17 apiece.
Leerink Partners, UBS Investment Bank, Piper Sandler, Stifel and Oppenheimer are underwriting Aspen's offering, while BofA Securities, Evercore ISI, UBS Investment Bank and Cantor are handling Bambusa's.
Aspen will list on the Nasdaq under the symbol "ASPE," and Bambusa under "BBTX."

items.title: Após retorno de  líder da oposição, presidenta interina  da Venezuela diz esperar que diálogo ofereça espaço para todas as vozes
items.author: Deisy Buitrago
items.creator: Deisy Buitrago
items.summary: A presidente interina da Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que espera que as negociações com uma facção da oposição ofereçam espaço para que todas as vozes sejam ouvidas, um dia após o retorno da líder da oposição, María Corina Machado, ao país.
items.body:
A presidente interina da Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que espera que as negociações com uma facção da oposição ofereçam espaço para que todas as vozes sejam ouvidas, um dia após o retorno da líder da oposição, María Corina Machado, ao país.
“Espero que o diálogo continue a proporcionar um espaço para a participação política e que aqueles que prejudicaram a Venezuela, aqueles que clamaram por sanções e agressão externa, sintam algum remorso e arrependimento”, disse a presidente interina durante uma visita a um hospital militar em Caracas. “Espero que tanto o diálogo quanto o programa de coexistência democrática e paz possam proporcionar um espaço onde todas as vozes possam ser ouvidas, onde as vozes que buscam o bem do país possam ser ouvidas.”
O retorno de Machado à Venezuela, após várias tentativas frustradas, corre o risco de prejudicar suas relações com o governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump. Washington afirmou que ela tem todo o direito de estar na Venezuela, mas elogiou Rodríguez e apoia um processo de negociação entre o governo de Rodríguez e grupos da oposição que não inclua o movimento Vente Venezuela, de Machado.
As negociações, que continuaram neste mês, visariam reformular o conselho eleitoral e o tribunal superior antes de eventuais eleições.
