items.title: YPF, Vista y Tecpetrol impulsaron el salto de las emisiones de deuda corporativa en septiembre
items.author: Florencia Lendoiro
items.summary: Las tres petroleras colocaron US$2.050 millones en los mercados internacionales durante septiembre, según PwC. El total de obligaciones negociables alcanzó los US$2.722 millones, el segundo mayor regi ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — Las petroleras YPF , Tecpetrol y Vista ( VIST ) concentraron más del 75% de las emisiones de deuda corporativa registradas en Argentina durante septiembre de 2026, según datos del último informe de mercado de capitales de PwC. Las tres compañías captaron US$2.050 millones mediante colocaciones internacionales, frente a un total de US$2.722 millones en obligaciones negociables (ON) emitidas por empresas argentinas. El monto total representó el segundo mayor registro mensual desde 2015, únicamente superado por noviembre de 2025, cuando las emisiones alcanzaron los US$2.954 millones. Las cifras corresponden a nuevas colocaciones de deuda, medidas al tipo de cambio contado con liquidación (CCL). VER MÁS: “Vaca Muerta va a derramar, pero hay que ayudarla”: la receta del CEO de Tecpetrol para aprovechar el boom El elevado nivel de actividad se produjo pese al incremento del riesgo país, que durante septiembre pasó de 512 a 607 puntos básicos. De cara a los próximos meses, PwC consideró que se mantienen condiciones favorables para las emisiones corporativas. La consultora señaló que las tasas relativamente bajas en el segmento de deuda en dólares y en el financiamiento de pymes garantizadas podrían continuar impulsando las colocaciones tanto en el mercado local como en el internacional. VER MÁS: YPF ya produce 248.000 barriles diarios y Marín apuesta a que Vaca Muerta llegue a dos millones La mayor operación correspondió a YPF, que emitió US$1.200 millones mediante su obligación negociable Clase LXIV, a nueve años de plazo y con una tasa del 7,85% nominal anual. Fue la segunda colocación más grande de la compañía y de Argentina desde 2015, solo por detrás de los US$1.500 millones emitidos por la petrolera estatal en abril de ese año. VER MÁS: YPF hizo una colocación histórica de deuda por US$1.200 millones: es la segunda mayor desde 2015 Por su parte, Tecpetrol colocó US$450 millones mediante una ampliación de su ON Clase 10, bajo legislación de Nueva York, con una tasa de corte del 7,25%. En tanto, Vista Energy Argentina emitió US$400 millones a través de una ampliación de su ON Clase XXXI, también bajo legislación estadounidense, con una tasa del 7,95%. Así se mueven las acciones de Vista. Símbolo: VISTAA:MF. Clase de activo: equity. PwC destacó que, a pesar de la escalada del riesgo país durante los últimos dos meses, las emisiones internacionales continuaron firmes, con el sector de petróleo y gas a la cabeza. “Las tasas de colocación de estas emisiones experimentaron una compresión significativa y se encuentran en niveles mínimos de la actual gestión, en torno al promedio del 7,7% TNA”, señaló un reporte de la compañía. Durante septiembre se concretaron 42 emisiones de obligaciones negociables, la tercera mayor cantidad de la serie histórica de PwC, detrás de octubre de 2024, con 49 operaciones, y agosto de ese año, con 47. El crecimiento también estuvo impulsado por las pequeñas y medianas empresas. Las ON bajo el régimen PYME CNV Garantizada alcanzaron 15 colocaciones, el máximo de los últimos dos años, por un total equivalente a ARS$41.725 millones. En cuanto al costo del financiamiento, la tasa promedio de colocación en pesos del régimen general descendió al 28,5% nominal anual, frente al 29,3% de agosto. En cambio, la tasa promedio de las emisiones en dólares aumentó del 5,1% al 6,1%.

items.title: Boeing forecast to post small quarterly loss despite recent wins, analysts say
items.author: Dan Catchpole
items.creator: Dan Catchpole
items.summary: Despite a flurry of wins for Boeing in recent months, Wall Street analysts expect the planemaker to post a loss per share of 21 cents when it reports its third-quarter results on Tuesday, according to LSEG data.
items.body:
Despite a flurry of wins for Boeing (BA.N) in recent months, Wall Street analysts expect the planemaker to post a loss per share of 21 cents when it reports its third-quarter results on Tuesday, according to LSEG data.
During the third quarter, the company won the US Navy's sixth-generation F/A-XX fighter contract and certified the last two 737 MAX variants. It delivered 363 737 MAX jets through the first nine months of 2026, its fastest pace ever.
Nonetheless, as of market open on Monday, Boeing's share price was down 17.3% year to date.
BNP Paribas analyst Matt Akers told Reuters that investors care most about free cash flow and its major driver — deliveries — and current drains — 777-9 certification and building new defense production facilities.
While Boeing hit a new record for 737 MAX deliveries, increasing its production rate has taken longer than executives had expected. The company is currently trying to stabilize output at 47 737 jets a month.
It has also struggled to increase 787 production from eight jets a month to 10.
Boeing's recent successes had already been accounted for by the market, and they had little effect on the company's share price, Akers said.
Highlights of investment analysts' consensus expectations, according to LSEG data:
$330.5 million in free cash flow in the third quarter, $2.3 billion for the year.
$905 million in capital expenditures.
Net loss of $153 million, compared to an actual net loss of almost $6 billion during the same period in 2025.
Net debt of $25.4 billion, down from $30.4 billion one year ago.

items.title: Lori Keith Sees Long AI Growth as Anthropic files IPO
items.summary: Discussing Anthropic’s IPO filing, portfolio manager Lori Keith described AI’s shift from pilot projects toward companies capturing measurable economic value. She said Anthropic’s customer growth signals strong demand: nearly 12,000 customers spend at least $100,000 annually, up from about 950 a year earlier, and more than 1,900 spend at least $1 million. Keith said adoption remains early, with engineering and coding among the leading uses and customer service and other applications broadening. She sees opportunities not only for AI infrastructure and chip providers, but also for downstream businesses and companies supplying power and water infrastructure. The discussion also noted a filing disclosure that one customer accounted for more than 10% of Anthropic’s revenue as of June 30. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Jio IPO falls short of record payday for bankers despite mega issue
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Jio Platforms is paying 19 banks about ₹196 crore in fees for its $3.1 billion IPO, just 0.65% of the issue size, as fierce competition squeezes investment banking earnings.
items.body: Jio Platforms raised a record amount of funds for billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s digital and telecommunications giant, but it proved to be far less lucrative for the bankers handling the deal. The company is paying about ₹196 crore ($20.7 million) in fees to the 19 banks on the roughly $3.1 billion IPO, according to filings. That amounts to about 0.65 per cent of the issue size, trailing the fee pools of several previous offerings in India. Fierce competition among investment bankers in India has compressed fees, particularly for marquee deals. Firms are often willing to accept thinner economics for a coveted role on high-profile transactions. The payoff can instead come through league-table rankings, bragging rights and credentials that help win the next big pitch. That’s a far cry from the days when Hyundai Motor India paid about ₹490 crore to bankers for its then-record ₹27,800 crore IPO in 2024. Paytm parent One 97 Communications paid about ₹320 crore for its ₹18,300 crore offering in 2021, while Swiggy Ltd handed out about ₹280 crore for its ₹11,300 crore share sale. Those types of windfalls have been elusive of late. National Stock Exchange of India, another blockbuster IPO this year, paid about ₹190 crore to a syndicate of 20 banks that worked on its roughly $2.4 billion offering, equivalent to about 0.8 per cent of the issue size. Bankers split fees of just ₹4.63 crore for SBI Funds Management of India’s billion-dollar offering in July. Investor enthusiasm, meanwhile, has been anything but restrained. Jio’s IPO was fully subscribed within the first 100 minutes of bidding and had attracted bids for nearly 22 times the shares on offer by Friday, according to BSE data.

items.title: Now home, Venezuela opposition leader Machado walks tightrope with supporters, Trump
items.author: Mayela Armas, Julia Symmes Cobb
items.creator: Mayela Armas, Julia Symmes Cobb
items.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups.
items.body:
Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups.
Machado's return to Venezuela after [USN:L1N45F02O TEXT:"several failed attempts"] risks [USN:L1N42Y0X4 TEXT:"straining her ties"] with US President Donald Trump's administration. Washington has said she has every right to be in Venezuela, but has praised acting President Delcy Rodriguez and supports a negotiation process between the Rodriguez government and opposition groups that do not include Machado's Vente Venezuela movement.
The talks, which have continued this month, would remake the electoral council and top court ahead of eventual elections. Both bodies are staffed by ruling party loyalists and backed ousted President Nicolas Maduro in a disputed 2024 presidential election, despite tallies published by Machado's movement that showed her candidate had won. The Trump administration captured Maduro in January.
Machado supporters, tens of thousands of whom swarmed her caravan between Barquisimeto and Caracas on Sunday, waving flags, chanting her name and festooning her with rosaries, are [USN:L2N46B03Y TEXT:"eager for elections"] and call her the next president. She has said a presidential vote should happen in 2027.
Machado's team did not immediately responded to requests for comment.
Asked whether Machado would participate in the negotiations, Rodriguez said she hopes the dialogue will lead those who called for sanctions against the country - a common ruling party critique leveled at Machado - to feel remorse. Rodriguez added that the talks offer a chance for all voices to be heard.
“I hope both the dialogue and the program for democratic coexistence and peace can provide a space where all voices can be heard, where voices seeking the good of the country can be heard," the acting president said during a visit to a military hospital in Caracas, where she urged politicians to concentrate on serious issues and not putting on a "show".
Though Machado [USN:L4N3W51LU TEXT:"cultivated Trump as an ally"] for years, he said last month it was [USN:L1N44V0SA TEXT:"too soon to consider democratic elections."] On Sunday, Trump said he had been unaware of her return plans, though a person briefed on her movements disputed that.
RISK OF SHORT CIRCUIT WITH WASHINGTON Machado's eagerness for a vote could "short-circuit" the relationship with the US and its three-phase stabilization, recovery and transition plan for Venezuela, said Ricardo Rios, head of Poder y Estrategia, a political risk consultancy.
"The idea (at the negotiations) is to hold a regional election before a presidential election. She will probably push for electoral guarantees and for a presidential election to be held as soon as possible," Rios said.
But much remains to be defined before voters cast ballots.
“What guarantees does the ruling sector have to leave power (if it is defeated)?" Rios asked. "That still needs to be defined in order to make this viable, because otherwise, no matter how popular she is, it complicates matters."
US AND EU URGE DIALOGUE Machado's safe return was a direct outcome of the negotiations, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longtime champion of Machado, said on Sunday, adding he expects all political actors to support the talks.
The EU echoed that sentiment, saying on Monday authorities and all political actors should advance "an inclusive, Venezuelan-led dialogue towards free and fair elections."
"The reception she got yesterday will only reinforce the tendency to demand instant results," said Phil Gunson, senior analyst for the Andes region at the International Crisis Group think tank. "Not only might that provoke a reaction from government hardliners, but it could — if successful — produce a political rupture instead of a peaceful transition, with inadequate post-electoral guarantees and a potentially ungovernable country."
The opposition included in the talks, led by Dinorah Figuera, a lawmaker elected in 2015 to the last Venezuelan legislative body recognized by the US, said Machado's return was a significant step in the US plan.
“Her role is also tied to how she interprets the signals from the United States, which has called for reconstruction and reconciliation. She has to be an ally in the negotiations," said Oswaldo Ramirez, managing director of ORC Consultores.
"Rubio sent a clear message," he added. “I don’t see her trying to torpedo the negotiations. She can’t stray outside the lines.”

items.title: Dollar General overcharged shoppers, FTC and states allege in lawsuit
items.author: Jody Godoy
items.creator: Jody Godoy
items.summary: Dollar General repeatedly charged more than advertised prices even after receiving tens of thousands of consumer complaints, the US Federal Trade Commission and 20 states alleged in a lawsuit filed on Monday.
items.body:
Dollar General (DG.N) repeatedly charged more than advertised prices even after receiving tens of thousands of consumer complaints, the US Federal Trade Commission and 20 states alleged in a lawsuit filed on Monday.
Dollar General, which appeals to low-income consumers with bargain prices, made millions of dollars by failing to honor prices advertised on fliers and shelves at checkout, the FTC and states allege.
The discount retailer's stock was down more than 4% on Monday afternoon.
"Dollar General has, for years, repeatedly mislabeled prices, overcharged consumers and failed to correct the issue despite extensive corporate knowledge of the problem," the FTC and states said in a statement.
Representatives for Dollar General did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The lawsuit cited numerous complaints from consumers, failed inspections conducted by state authorities, and undercover shopping sprees conducted by the FTC.
Portions of the lawsuit detailing the company's knowledge of the practices were largely redacted.
California joined the FTC lawsuit along with Florida, Illinois, Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Tennessee and 13 other states.
Since 2019, Dollar General has paid $6 million in settlements with six states over inaccurate pricing, according to the complaint.

items.title: Soja, café e açúcar caem nas bolsas globais com alta do dólar após eleição no Brasil
items.author: P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel
items.creator: P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil.
O Brasil é o maior produtor de soja, café e açúcar, enquanto o dólar mais forte frente ao real torna os produtos mais acessíveis para compradores no exterior. A moeda norte-americana mais valorizada também impulsiona vendas de exportadores.
O real brasileiro enfraqueceu perto de 12% em relação ao dólar norte-americano no mercado à vista, quando as negociações no Brasil tiveram início nesta segunda-feira, e a bolsa de valores do país suspendeu as negociações por meio de um mecanismo de segurança de interrupção automática, na esteira da reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
O mercado reverteu o otimismo que se instalou entre os investidores quando o rival de direita, Flávio Bolsonaro, liderou o primeiro turno das eleições no início do mês.
Operadores afirmaram que a surpreendente reviravolta foi particularmente negativa para os futuros de soja dos EUA, concorrentes do Brasil neste mercado.
"Certamente a eleição foi uma surpresa, e isso está ligado à desvalorização da moeda e, consequentemente, à queda nos preços da soja", disse Jack Scoville, vice-presidente e analista de mercado do The Price Futures Group, em Chicago.
"A magnitude do movimento nos preços da soja decorre disso e também exerceu alguma pressão indireta sobre o milho."
O contrato novembro da soja fechou em baixa de 15,25 centavos, cotado a US$12,4125 por bushel.
Os preços da soja também foram pressionados pela chegada da colheita recorde dos EUA ao mercado.
Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto negociados na bolsa ICE , considerados uma referência global de preços, recuaram 5,6%, para fechar a 19,10 centavos de dólar por libra-peso.
Já os contratos futuros de café arábica na ICE caíram 2,1%, para US$3,0095 por libra-peso, distanciando-se da máxima de seis semanas registrada na quarta-feira, de US$3,1820.
O açúcar refinado terminou em queda de 3,6% para US$515,40 a tonelada, enquanto o café robusta perdeu 1,3% para US$3.201 a tonelada.
Já o milho negociado em Chicago terminou com leve baixa de 1 centavo, a US$4,55 o bushel, pressionado pelo avanço da colheita nos EUA.
O trigo caiu 9 centavos, para US$6,16 o bushel, em meio a uma nova proposta de reabertura segura das exportações de grãos pelo Mar Negro, onde terminais estão limitados por conta da guerra entre Ucrânia e Rússia.
(Por P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

Oct 26 : World number one Jannik Sinner will make his comeback at the Six Kings Slam in Saudi Arabia following the tournament's postponement to December due to security concerns, organisers said on Monday.
Italian Sinner, winner of the previous two Six Kings, announced this month that he would not compete again in 2026 as he continued his recovery from a knee injury that has sidelined the 25-year-old since winning Wimbledon in July.
That decision ruled him out of the European indoor hardcourt swing along with the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin where Sinner also triumphed in the last two years.
The lucrative Six Kings Slam exhibition event, a non-ATP tournament, was due to take place in Riyadh from October 21-24, but is now scheduled for December 27-30.

Organisers announced the date change after an attack by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis on Riyadh's international airport killed 13 people.
January's Dakar Rally was moved out of Saudi Arabia due to security concerns, and golf's Asian Tour has postponed the Saudi International indefinitely.
Sinner beat Carlos Alcaraz in both Six Kings finals, earning himself $6 million at each event.
Along with Sinner and Alcaraz, the event will also feature Novak Djokovic, Alexander Zverev, Taylor Fritz and Alex de Minaur. Zverev is guaranteed to finish 2026 as the ATP's year-end world number one.

Source: Reuters

NEW YORK: Wall St reet's m ai n indexes edged up on Monday (Oct 26), led by advances in technology shares, while inve st ors assessed Anthropic's IPO filing at the st art of a week packed with corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's intere st -rate decision.
Anthropic disclosed st eep losses and red-hot revenue growth in its filing for a US initial public offering, laying out its ambition to build AI sy st ems capable of reshaping the global economy despite the high co st s of developing the technology.
The AI lab is pushing ahead with its li st ing plans even as a once-busy fall li st ing calendar has thinned out, with market volatility prompting companies to delay offerings.
"It's a challenging environment, to say the lea st exactly when this IPO will take place, but there's a lot riding on not only the company, but the AI indu st ry," s ai d Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth In F ai rfield.

Semiconductor and chip-related companies, widely viewed as some of the bigge st winners of the AI boom, were leading the g ai ns. The broader Philadelphia chips index was up around 1 per cent after a turbulent few weeks.
Anthropic's filing also arrived at a time when inve st ors are increasingly scrutinising the payoff from AI spending. About a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings this week, including hyperscalers Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon.com, whose results would be closely watched for signs if the hefty AI inve st ments are translating into growth.
The focus follows a subdued reception to earnings from AI -linked megacaps la st week. Meta disappointed inve st ors after r ai sing its annual AI spending foreca st ag ai n and s ai d it would sell new st ock to help pay for it, while Tesla also came under pressure after its results.
Meta s ai d on Monday it plans to r ai se up to US$95 billion in equity to fund its AI -related expansion of data centres, cloud computing power and other infra st ructure. Its shares were la st down 1.8 per cent.
The AI trade has come under pressure this month amid concerns that debt-funded spending may become harder to ju st ify in the face of rising borrowing co st s.
Neocloud firm CoreWeave fell 2 per cent and Nebius dipped 4.8 per cent after Elon Musk s ai d in an X po st markets have "almo st entirely shut off access to money" for companies without sub st antial revenue independent of AI data centres, and predicted neocloud consolidation.
At 9:55am ET (9:55pm, Singapore time), the Dow Jones Indu st rial Average .DJI rose 236.42 points, or 0.45 per cent, to 52,451.58. The S&P 500 .SPX g ai ned 43.20 points, or 0.57 per cent, to 7,666.88, while the Nasdaq Composite .IXIC edged up 119.43 points, or 0.46 per cent, at 26,074.96.

Related:

Anthropic quietly pitches its own AI safety Bill to US lawmakers

Commentary: PHP vulnerabilities - why the good guys have notched a victory in AI-cybersecurity age

Market breadth was st rong, with 10 of the 11 S&P 500 sectors trading higher. Consumer discretionary .SPLRCD and indu st rials .SPLRCI led the g ai ns.
Megacap and growth st ocks were mixed. Tesla jumped 5.9 per cent to a more than three-month high after Barclays upgraded its rating on the st ock to "overweight" from "equal-weight".
Crude oil prices eased after hitting a near six-month high la st week. On Sunday, Qatari mediators travelled to Tehran as part of an effort to de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the United St ates.
Elsewhere, the Fed's rate decision is due on Wednesday, with a pause widely expected after its September r ai se. Trade rs st ill see a December hike as firmly possible, and at lea st two 25-basis-point increases by mid-2027, according to LSEG data.
Both the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, the Personal Consumption Expenditures index for September, and third-quarter GDP, expected to show 3.2 per cent growth, are due on Thursday.
Inve st ors are also monitoring the Nov 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.73-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.25-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
The S&P 500 po st ed three new 52-week highs and three new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 44 new highs and 180 new lows.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: ＡＩ銘柄上昇、アンソロピックがＩＰＯ申請書類公開　ナスダック約320ポイント高
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、ＡＩ（人工知能）のインフラ投資が債務に依存しているとの警戒感が強まる中、同関連株が上昇した。ＡＩ開発のアンソロピックが米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開したことが材料となった。

時価総額世界一の半導体大手エヌビディアの株価は３％近く上昇。マイクロソフトとアマゾンも、それぞれ１％近く上げた。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は一時、約３２０ポイント上昇。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３％超上昇した。

アナリストらは、アンソロピックのような巨大ＡＩ専業企業が上場に成功すれば、半導体メーカーや関連インフラ企業など、急成長している同業界の一角に対する市場の評価の仕方が変わる可能性があると指摘している。また、投資家がＡＩ関連の新たな投資先を組み入れようとポートフォリオの再配分を進めれば、一部の大手テクノロジー企業から資金が流出する可能性もある。

オールスプリング・グローバル・インベストメンツのマイケル・スミス氏は「結局のところ、現在ＡＩに投資するということは、話題を集める有名銘柄の先にある機会を探すことだ」と指摘。「現在、ＡＩ分野における魅力的な投資機会は、拡大するインフラ上の懸念を効率的かつ迅速に解決できる中小企業にあるかもしれない」と述べた。

items.title: Anthropic vs OpenAI: How Claude maker’s growth is challenging ChatGPT ahead of IPO
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Anthropic has seen significant revenue growth, reaching $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026. OpenAI continues to expand its business model while generating substantial revenues from its consumer and enterprise offerings. Both companies face financial pressures as they invest heavily in infrastructure and computing power. The competition between Anthropic and OpenAI is primarily driven by their customer acquisition strategies and operational efficiencies.
items.body: Anthropic has emerged as a strong challenger to OpenAI in the race to sell artificial intelligence to businesses, with its revenue rising sharply as demand for its Claude models grows. But investors weighing the two companies must look beyond sales growth to understand which business is better placed to deliver returns.Anthropic, which unveiled its initial public offering filing on Monday, reported revenue of $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026. OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, reported quarterly revenue of $6.7 billion in the second quarter, according to Reuters.The figures suggest Anthropic has built strong momentum in the enterprise market, where companies pay to use AI for software development, data analysis and other business tasks. But the comparison is not straightforward because the two companies account for some sales through cloud partners differently.OpenAI has also been expanding rapidly and remains a major player in the consumer AI market. The competition between the two companies is therefore likely to depend on their ability to attract paying customers, control computing costs and turn revenue growth into cash.Revenue growth favours AnthropicAnthropic’s revenue rose to $4.59 billion in 2025 from $386 million in 2024, according to its IPO filing. Revenue for the first six months of 2026 reached $16.29 billion.The company has benefited from growing demand for Claude, particularly its coding tools, which help software developers write, check and fix code. Its products are also used by businesses seeking to automate work and build AI-powered applications.OpenAI, meanwhile, has expanded beyond ChatGPT into business software, developer tools and AI agents. Reuters reported in October that OpenAI’s annualised revenue run rate for September was close to $50 billion, lower than the nearly $70 billion figure it had previously indicated to investors.An annualised revenue run rate estimates a full year’s revenue by extending a recent period’s sales. It is not the same as revenue actually earned over a year.Also Read: Anthropic IPO: 5 jaw-dropping numbers investors need to know about $1.5 trillion public offerIt should be noted that Anthropic records the full value of certain sales made through cloud marketplaces as revenue and records the platform fees separately. OpenAI does not include some similar cloud-partner sales in its revenue figures.This difference makes it difficult to determine which company has the larger underlying business from headline revenue alone.The profitability questionRapid revenue growth has not removed the financial risks facing either company.Anthropic reported an operating loss of $693 million in the first half of 2026, according to its IPO filing. Its reported net loss was much larger, at $80.7 billion, largely because of a non-cash accounting charge linked to the increased estimated value of bonds that may eventually convert into company shares.The operating loss provides a better indication of the gap between the company’s operating income and expenses during the period, although it does not by itself show how much cash the company generated or used.OpenAI also faces heavy spending requirements. Reuters reported in September, citing a Financial Times report, that the company expected to use about $278 billion in cash between 2026 and 2030 as it invests in computing power and infrastructure.The figures are not directly comparable because they cover different periods and measures. However, they underline the challenge facing both companies: advanced AI requires large investments in computing capacity, data centres, chips and research before the companies can generate sustainable returns.Computing costs and Big Tech dependenceAnthropic depends heavily on Amazon and Google for computing infrastructure and access to business customers. Both companies are also investors in Anthropic and compete with it in AI.Reuters reported that Amazon and Google’s cloud marketplaces accounted for 47% of Anthropic’s sales to customers in 2025. These relationships help Claude reach businesses already using their cloud services, but they also expose Anthropic to dependence on a small number of powerful partners.OpenAI has its own infrastructure requirements and strategic partnerships, including its close relationship with Microsoft. It has also been committing substantial sums to secure computing capacity for future AI development.The companies’ ability to manage these commitments will be important as competition increases. If AI usage grows more slowly than expected, large infrastructure obligations could weigh on cash flow. If demand continues to rise rapidly, access to computing power could become a competitive advantage.Also Read : Anthropic IPO: What should investors consider when valuing the AI company? Aswath Damodaran explainsValuation will determine investor returnsBoth companies are seeking valuations that reflect expectations of enormous future growth.Anthropic has been valued by some investors at around $1.5 trillion in recent discussions, below expectations of about $2 trillion reported earlier. OpenAI has also been linked to a potential valuation exceeding $1.4 trillion in recent fundraising talks, according to Reuters.These are reported private-market valuations and fundraising discussions, not necessarily the final prices at which either company’s shares will be offered to public investorA higher valuation does not automatically mean a company is better placed. Investors must assess how much future growth is already reflected in the price and whether the company can deliver the revenue and profits needed to justify it.Anthropic’s upcoming IPO could provide a useful benchmark for valuing AI businesses. OpenAI’s eventual listing, expected later, could give investors another opportunity to compare the companies using more detailed financial disclosures.Which business is better placed?Anthropic currently has a strong case based on its rapid revenue growth and position in business AI, particularly coding. Its latest disclosures also give investors a clearer view of its operating performance and infrastructure commitments.OpenAI has a broad consumer presence through ChatGPT, a growing enterprise business and significant financial and technology partnerships. Its scale gives it opportunities to sell AI products across a wide range of users and applications.

items.title: Papa está em condições de realizar viagem à América Latina em novembro, diz Vaticano
items.author: Alvise Armellini
items.creator: Alvise Armellini
items.summary: A viagem do papa Leão 14 ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru seguirá adiante, informou o Vaticano nesta segunda-feira, indicando que a recuperação de Leão após a cirurgia de câncer de pulmão estava ocorrendo conforme o previsto e que ele estava em condições de realizar a viagem de 6 a 17 de novembro.
items.body:
A viagem do papa Leão 14 ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru seguirá adiante, informou o Vaticano nesta segunda-feira, indicando que a recuperação de Leão após a cirurgia de câncer de pulmão estava ocorrendo conforme o previsto e que ele estava em condições de realizar a viagem de 6 a 17 de novembro.
O pontífice, de 71 anos, está se recuperando de uma cirurgia realizada em 13 de outubro, na qual os médicos removeram o lobo inferior do pulmão direito e diagnosticaram um adenocarcinoma pulmonar, a forma mais comum de câncer de pulmão.
“A recuperação do Santo Padre após a cirurgia continua, e os exames médicos mais recentes atestam sua boa saúde e condição clínica favorável”, afirmou o Vaticano em comunicado, citando o médico pessoal de Leão, Luigi Carbone.
“Com base em seu quadro clínico atual, bem como nos exames instrumentais e laboratoriais realizados, não há contraindicações que o impeçam de realizar sua próxima viagem apostólica”, afirmou o comunicado.
PAPA RETORNA À REGIÃO QUE BEM CONHECE A viagem de Leão à América do Sul deve ser uma das viagens ao exterior mais intensas realizadas por um líder católico nas últimas décadas. O papa deve percorrer cerca de 31.000 km ao longo da viagem por 10 cidades e proferir 36 discursos.
O Vaticano informou que a viagem seguirá adiante sem alterações na agenda divulgada anteriormente.
Leão passou décadas como missionário no Peru antes de seu antecessor, Francisco, chamá-lo de volta a Roma em 2023 e promovê-lo a cargos no Vaticano. A viagem, portanto, marcará uma espécie de volta ao lar para o primeiro pontífice norte-americano.
“Estou ansioso para retornar ao continente onde vivi tantos momentos da minha vida”, disse ele na mensagem do Vaticano.
“Que esta viagem seja uma ocasião para abrirmos nossos corações uns aos outros, fortalecermos nossa comunhão como irmãos e irmãs e renovarmos nosso compromisso de proclamar o Evangelho com alegria”, disse Leão.
Em seu comunicado, o Vaticano informou que Leão estava “ajustando sua agenda diária em consulta com seus médicos para priorizar sua recuperação, ao mesmo tempo em que continua a cumprir as responsabilidades de seu ministério”.
No domingo, o papa dirigiu-se aos fiéis na Praça de São Pedro, mas, por recomendação médica, cancelou uma visita de um dia à cidade de Assis, no centro da Itália, que estava marcada para terça-feira.

items.title: エジプト議会、サウジ軍事支援承認　対フーシ派に直接関与の可能性
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２６日　ロイター] - エジプト議会は２６日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃を受けているサウジアラビアの自衛を支援するため、シシ大統領に「あらゆる必要な措置」を講じる権限を認めた。これにより、サウジとフーシ派の紛争にエジプトが直接的に関与する可能性が高まった。

シシ大統領は、サウジから支援要請があった場合にエジプト軍による支援を認めるよう議会に求めていた。ロイターが議会関係者から入手した議会声明によると、出席議員の少なくとも３分の２以上が賛成した。

サウジはエジプトにとって主要な政治・財政支援国で、これまでに数十億ドル規模の支援やエネルギー供給などを実施。エジプトはこれまでも、イランやイランが支援する勢力による湾岸諸国への攻撃をたびたび非難してきた。ただ、サウジ、トルコ、パキスタンの８月に締結した相互防衛協定「メッカ共同防衛協定」には参加しておらず、直接的な軍事行動にも公には加わっていない。

メッカ共同防衛協定を締結したサウジア、トルコ、パキスタンの高官はこの日、イランの首都テヘランでイラン指導部との会合を開いている。

Anthropic discloses month-long training pause, AI security breaches in IPO filing

FAST

Oct 26 : Anthropic paused training of its next-generation flagship AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four of its AI agents accessed live external computer systems during testing, its initial public offering filing showed on Monday.
The Claude maker said in the filing's risk factors section that it had delayed pre-training of a new "frontier" base model to strengthen safeguards against the theft of model weights and intellectual property.
The disclosure highlights the safety challenges facing developers of increasingly powerful AI models, some of whose creators have warned the technology could eventually escape human control. Rival OpenAI also paused some training earlier this year over safety concerns after its models hacked Hugging Face.
The incidents illustrate how unexpected safety failures could disrupt development and deployment of models central to Anthropic's growth as it prepares for a widely anticipated stock market debut.

Anthropic warned that training pauses could delay revenue and leave it trailing competitors. The company devoted about 94 pages to risk factors, more than in its confidential filing seen by Reuters.
SANDBOX ESCAPE
The filing also detailed previously undisclosed safety evaluation failures in which four AI models escaped their testing environments and accessed real-world computer systems, with sessions lasting between 10 and 34 hours.
Anthropic said an error during cybersecurity tests with a third-party partner left the testing environment connected to the internet despite instructions that web access be disabled.
In one instance, an early version of the model continued pursuing an impossible evaluation task, discovered a stored password and used it to gain administrator access to a third party's system. It then obtained additional credentials, changed system settings and accessed an individual's personal data. The filing did not identify the external parties involved.
Anthropic said it notified all affected parties and found no evidence that the models had sought to evade human oversight or coordinate with each other. It subsequently suspended certain pre-release cybersecurity evaluations and paused higher-risk reinforcement learning environments.
Separately, the company said on Sunday that Claude had bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available aggregate voter counts from the US state of Georgia without human authorization.

Source: Reuters

Oct 26 : Microsoft said on Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, or more than a quarter of its global workforce, as the technology giant looks to contain costs and help fund its massive AI investments.
Staffers across the Windows maker would be eligible for the offers, including those working in AI experiences, Copilot, finance, human resources, Xbox and Windows + Devices, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters, requesting anonymity as the matter was private. Units such as marketing, commercial business and security will be excluded, the source added.
"This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs," Chief People Officer Amy Coleman said in a staff memo.
Like other tech giants, Microsoft is spending hundreds of billions of dollars on AI data centers and chips, drawing scrutiny from investors over whether the returns will justify the staggering cost. The company, slated to report first-quarter results after markets close on Wednesday, has forecast $175 billion in capital expenditures for the 2026 calendar year.

The company earlier this year offered voluntary buyouts to about 7 per cent of its US workforce, or about 9,000 employees.
In July, Microsoft announced it would cut 4,800 jobs, or about 2.1 per cent of its global workforce, overhauling its Xbox gaming business and divesting up to five studios as it looks to boost returns after years of heavy investment in the division.
"This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below," Microsoft said on Monday.
The company said it was a time-limited, voluntary program and built on insights gained from a previous voluntary retirement program. The eligible employees will receive details within the next few hours, it added.

items.title: Colombia lanza emisión de bonos globales en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años: IFR
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes una emisión de bonos globales en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG.
items.body:
El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes una emisión de bonos globales en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG.
Las emisiones tienen como propósito financiar el presupuesto de gastos del país sudamericano, aunque no se informó inmediatamente si se utilizarán para cubrir necesidades de este año o para prefinanciar el 2027.
Los vencimientos están propuestos para 2032, 2037 y 2056, agregó el artículo.
IFR precisó que los bonos a 5 años tienen una tasa guía de 7,10%, a 10 años un 7,70% y a 30 años entre un 8,15% y 8,25%.
Según agentes del mercado, el Gobierno busca emitir alrededor de 5.000 millones de dólares.
Los agentes colocadores de la operación son BBVA, Itaú y JP Morgan.
Colombia ya había finalizado sus necesidades de financiamiento de este año vía bonos internacionales, aunque la semana pasada anunció un recorte de 13,8 billones de pesos (4.326 millones de dólares) en el presupuesto, inferior a los 21,9 billones de pesos que pretendía reducir, lo que supondría necesidad de más recursos.
El presupuesto de 2027 propone colocaciones de deuda pública interna por 150,9 billones de pesos y endeudamiento externo por unos 26.101 millones de dólares vía emisiones en el mercado internacional de capitales y préstamos con los bancos de desarrollo multilaterales y bilaterales.
El presidente De La Espriella anunció que en los próximos días radicará ante el Congreso la denominada “Ley de Rescate Económico”, una iniciativa con la que el Gobierno busca enfrentar los desequilibrios fiscales y presupuestales del próximo año.

FAST

Oct 26 : AI-linked stocks rose on Monday after Anthropic revealed the paperwork for its initial public offering, against the backdrop of growing investor unease over debt-fueled spending on infrastructure for the new technology.
Shares of Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, added nearly 3 per cent. Microsoft and Amazon gained nearly 1 per cent each.
A successful flotation by a pure-play AI giant such as Anthropic could reshape how markets value parts of the booming industry, including chipmakers and related infrastructure companies, analysts have said.
It could also divert capital from some tech heavyweights as investors make room in their portfolios for a new way to bet on the technology.

The industry's web of relationships adds another wrinkle, as some of the biggest technology companies are investors in both Anthropic and its chief rival, OpenAI.
Among other AI stocks, battered shares of neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius Group rose 5.7 per cent and 2.3 per cent, respectively, after the filing, reversing earlier losses following SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's comments.
Data center operators Applied Digital and IREN gained 1 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively.
Memory chipmaker Micron rose 3 per cent, and data-storage firms Sandisk, Western Digital and Seagate added about 2.5 per cent each.
AMD and Broadcom gained 2.5 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. Zoom Communications, an early investor in Anthropic, rose 1.5 per cent.
The broader Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up over 3 per cent.
Focus now shifts to a potential IPO from OpenAI. But while the stakes are high, the long-term impact of the IPOs on the AI trade remains uncertain.
"Ultimately, investing in AI today involves searching for opportunity beyond the headline names," said Michael Smith, head of the growth equity team at Allspring Global Investments.
"Today, attractive investment opportunities in AI may be in small and medium-sized firms that can efficiently and quickly solve growing infrastructure concerns."

Source: Reuters

Among other AI stocks, battered shares of neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius Group rose 5.7 per cent and 2.3 per cent, respectively, after the filing, reversing earlier losses following SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's comments.
Data center operators Applied Digital and IREN gained 1 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively.
Memory chipmaker Micron rose 3 per cent, and data-storage firms Sandisk, Western Digital and Seagate added about 2.5 per cent each.
AMD and Broadcom gained 2.5 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. Zoom Communications, an early investor in Anthropic, rose 1.5 per cent.
The broader Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up over 3 per cent.
Focus now shifts to a potential IPO from OpenAI. But while the stakes are high, the long-term impact of the IPOs on the AI trade remains uncertain.
"Ultimately, investing in AI today involves searching for opportunity beyond the headline names," said Michael Smith, head of the growth equity team at Allspring Global Investments.
"Today, attractive investment opportunities in AI may be in small and medium-sized firms that can efficiently and quickly solve growing infrastructure concerns."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Rendimiento de bonos Tesoro EEUU a 10 años cotiza estable, a la espera de la Fed
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés.
items.body:
El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés.
La presentación el lunes por parte de la empresa de IA Anthropic de la documentación para su oferta pública inicial (OPI) impulsó las acciones, y la IA seguirá siendo el centro de atención con las publicaciones de resultados de Microsoft
(MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) durante la semana.
Los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años se mantuvo en menos del 5%. El jueves pasado, el bono de referencia había anotado su mayor caída diaria de casi cuatro años, en un contexto de desplome las bolsas provocada por el temor sobre la sostenibilidad de la demanda de IA.
"La semana pasada hubo mucha volatilidad", dijo Jim Barnes, director de renta fija de Bryn Mawr Trust.
Los inversores quieren escuchar lo que digan esta semana las empresas relacionadas con la IA para hacerse una idea del gasto futuro, pero también de las perspectivas económicas generales, añadió.
"Esto está empezando a influir en las expectativas de los inversores respecto a los rendimientos de los bonos en el futuro", añadió.
Los inversores también estarán pendientes de la Fed, de la que se espera que mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios cuando anuncie su decisión de política monetaria el miércoles.
Las expectativas del mercado de un alza de tasas han bajado recientemente, en la medida en que los rendimientos se han moderado y los datos económicos han sido dispares. Los futuros sobre tasas de interés descontaban el lunes una probabilidad del 90% de que se mantengan las tasas sin cambios en la reunión de la Fed de esta semana, según CME FedWatch.
El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro a 10 años de referencia cotizaba casi sin cambios en 4,988%, mientras que el de 30 años perdía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 5,3%.
El retorno a dos años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Fed, caía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 4,714%.
Una parte de la curva de rendimientos que mide la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 2 y a 10 años , y que se considera un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 27,2 puntos básicos positivos. El diferencial se redujo a un mínimo de casi un mes.

items.title: アウディＣＥＯの米選挙集会参加に批判、社内規範違反と労組反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン　２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン　２６日　ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）傘下のアウディのデルナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１１月３日に控える米中間選挙の激戦州である南部ジョージア州で開かれた集会にトランプ米大統領と共に参加したことを受け、労働組合のトップは２６日、社内規範に違反しているとして批判した。

２４日の集会では、アウディによる４０億ドル規模の工場建設計画が発表された。自動車関税措置の影響を避けるため、年間２０万台のスポーツタイプ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）を生産する予定。これに対し、ドイツ最大の産業別労働組合ＩＧメタル会長でＶＷ監査役会に属するベンナー氏は「選挙期間中の政治的中立を求める自社規則に著しく違反している」と指摘した。計画には労働者代表を含むＶＷ監査役会の承認が必要となる。

関係者によると、アウディの経営陣は行動規範に対する例外を承認しており、別の労働組合関係者は反対しなかったものの懸念を表明したという。

トランプ氏はこれまでに極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」への支持を表明。ドイツの政財界の間では懸念が広がっている。ＶＷの第２の株主であるニーダーザクセン州のリース首相は、「選挙集会はこれほどの投資を発表するのにふさわしい場所ではない」とし、デルナー氏が政治的なショーの一環となったことは不適切だとの見方を示した。ＶＷグループのドイツ内の生産拠点は、コスト削減圧力を受け、人員削減などを進めている。

デルナー氏を「ミニ・イーロン・マスク」と称し、政治的言動で物議を醸した米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのＣＥＯになぞらえる指摘もある。

AUSTIN, Texas, Oct 26 : Mercedes F1 boss Toto Wolff has backed George Russell for future success after Red Bull's former motorsport adviser Helmut Marko dismissed the Briton's chances of ever recovering from being eclipsed by teammate Kimi Antonelli.
Antonelli is 123 points clear of Russell atop the Formula One standings, with 125 still to be won, and is set to become the sport's youngest-ever champion in Mexico City this weekend as well as the first Italian champion since 1953.
The 20-year-old has now won nine times in his second season to three for the more experienced Russell, who started the year as the bookmakers' favourite.
"Russell is no longer the number one driver." Marko, who left Red Bull last year, told Sky Germany ahead of Sunday's US Grand Prix, which Antonelli won from pole while Russell laboured home in eighth after collecting a five-second penalty.

"Antonelli has quite clearly taken that spot from him ... I doubt whether he'll ever have another chance at the world title or be given number one status anywhere," added the 83-year-old.
Wolff said while he respected the opinion of his fellow Austrian "not-so buddy", Marko was wrong.
"George has all the ability. I think the car doesn't suit him," he told reporters at the Circuit of the Americas.
"At the beginning of the season it's maybe difficult to cope with a situation where you're feeling like this is my year to come and then you have this wunderkind on the other side (of the garage) that starts to really chip away.
"I believe that in a new season, George - if we provide him with a quick car - has absolutely what he needs to win a championship.
"I think it's a bit too easy to say let's forget about all these years where he won in F2 and in F3, in his rookie years in the European championships back-to-back in kart. That's all still there."

items.title: CEO da Petrobras vê queda das ações após vitória de Lula como especulativa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A presidente da Petrobras , Magda Chambriard, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que a forte queda nas ações da estatal após a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi um "movimento especulativo" e não reflete os fundamentos da empresa.
items.body:
A presidente da Petrobras (PETR3.SA) , Magda Chambriard, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que a forte queda nas ações da estatal após a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi um "movimento especulativo" e não reflete os fundamentos da empresa.
Em entrevista à Reuters, Chambriard disse que a Petrobras continua sendo uma empresa sólida, com uma forte carteira de investimentos, e que não se deixará influenciar por movimentos de curto prazo do mercado.
"A hora é de comprar (ações). Infelizmente não posso", disse a executiva.
As ações da Petrobras negociadas na B3 caíam cerca de 10% nesta segunda-feira após o presidente Lula derrotar o senador Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno das eleições de domingo, contrariando as pesquisas e garantindo um quarto mandato não consecutivo.

items.title: Datagro vê queda de 5% na produção de açúcar do centro-sul em 26/27 e alta de 10,4% para etanol
items.author: Roberto Samora
items.creator: Roberto Samora
items.summary: A produção de açúcar do centro-sul do Brasil 2026/27 (abril/março) deverá atingir 38,42 milhões de toneladas, uma queda de 5% no comparativo com o ciclo anterior, por conta de impactos do El Niño e de uma redução na alocação de cana-de-açúcar para a fabricação do adoçante, estimou nesta segunda-feira a consultoria Datagro.
items.body:
A produção de açúcar do centro-sul do Brasil 2026/27 (abril/março) deverá atingir 38,42 milhões de toneladas, uma queda de 5% no comparativo com o ciclo anterior, por conta de impactos do El Niño e de uma redução na alocação de cana-de-açúcar para a fabricação do adoçante, estimou nesta segunda-feira a consultoria Datagro.
De outro lado, a fabricação total de etanol (de cana e milho) foi estimada em 37,2 bilhões de litros, avanço de 10,4%, com a expansão do setor de etanol de milho e também maior "mix" de cana para o biocombustível.
As projeções de açúcar e etanol indicam volumes menores em relação à perspectiva divulgada em maio pela Datagro, quando as chuvas associadas ao El Niño ainda não haviam afetado os trabalhos de moagem. Naquele mês, a Datagro projetava [USN:L1N41Q0MU TEXT:"40,98 milhões"] de toneladas de açúcar, enquanto a de etanol era vista em 38,61 bilhões de litros.
A estimativa de safra de cana do centro-sul, por outro lado, indica um crescimento de 4,8% no comparativo com o ciclo passado, para 640,5 milhões de toneladas, mas uma leve queda na comparação com a projeção de maio (642,2 milhões de toneladas).
Durante a apresentação em evento da consultoria, o presidente da Datagro, Plinio Nastari, citou que as chuvas atrapalharam a colheita e a moagem no centro-sul, principal região produtora de açúcar do mundo. Ele estimou 28,6 dias perdidos pelas precipitações, versus média histórica de 13,6 dias.
Essa perda é equivalente a cerca de 50 milhões de toneladas de cana que não foi processada, disse o consultor.
"Muitas usinas projetam levar a moagem de cana até a segunda quinzena de dezembro", disse Nastari, observando que os trabalhos deverão ser alongados, numa tentativa de minimizar a perda pelas chuvas.
Contudo, a Datagro ainda estima 34 milhões de toneladas de cana bisada em 31 de março de 2027, volume que deverá ser processado no ano que vem. O especialista disse que ainda é cedo para estimar o tamanho da safra 2027/28 no maior produtor global de açúcar, lembrando que é preciso acompanhar o clima e os preços das commodities.
Até 1º de outubro, a moagem no centro-sul havia somado 482,3 milhões de toneladas, queda de 1,6% no comparativo anual, segundo dados compilados pelo Ministério da Agricultura citados pelo especialista.
Segundo ele, o aumento do consumo de etanol no Brasil e o impacto do El Niño levaram a um aumento dos preços, ainda que as subvenções à gasolina e o controle de preços pela Petrobras impeçam um avanço ainda maior da demanda do biocombustível, em momento em que os preços do petróleo dispararam devido à guerra no Irã.
O "mix" de produção de cana para açúcar em 2026/27 deve cair para 46,7%, ante 50,4% no ciclo passado.
Já a produção de etanol de milho em 2026/27 deverá crescer 10,4% no comparativo anual, para 10,15 bilhões de litros, um crescimento abaixo do previsto inicialmente, disse Nastari.
ESTOQUES GLOBAIS O mercado global de açúcar no ano mundial 2026/27 (outubro/setembro) deverá ser deficitário em 3,92 milhões de toneladas (açúcar bruto equivalente), estimou a Datagro, ante um superávit de 730 mil toneladas no ciclo passado.
Essa redução acontece em meio a uma queda de cerca de 4 milhões de toneladas na produção de açúcar branco da União Europeia, para 12,7 milhões de toneladas, em 2026/27, devido à queda na área plantada.
"A União Europeia deve se voltar para maiores importações em 2026/27, com o volume podendo chegar a 3 milhões de toneladas", disse Nastari.
Ele vê uma estagnação no consumo global, o que tem impactado embarques do Brasil, que estão enfraquecidos.
Essa situação acontece diante do aumento da produção da China para patamares acima de 13 milhões de toneladas em 2025/26 e em 2026/27, versus 11 milhões em 2024/25.
"As importações (da China) em 2026/27 devem cair para 2,7 milhões de toneladas, metade do volume de 21/22", afirmou.

Unconventional AI buys Israeli chip startup NeuReality to speed product development

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 26 : Unconventional AI, the US hardware startup that launched less than a year ago with a $4.5 billion valuation, said on Monday that it is buying Israeli chip startup NeuReality for an undisclosed sum in a cash-and-stock deal.
Unconventional AI raised $475 million in December and is led by Naveen Rao, who previously sold chip startup Nervana to Intel for more than $400 million and AI software startup MosaicML to Databricks for $1.3 billion. It is backed by prominent Silicon Valley venture firms Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia, along with Amazon.com founder Jeff Bezos, among others.
Mountain View, California-based Unconventional AI's goal is to develop AI chips that are 1,000 times more energy efficient than current offerings by using concepts from biological systems. The company is focusing on what Rao calls a "dynamical systems" approach, in which simple computing elements interact with simple rules and evolve over time to reach a result, rather than following programmed step-by-step logic as conventional computing chips do.
In an interview, Rao said that when Unconventional AI raised its $475 million war chest of cash, the company expected to take three years in research and development and take five years to develop a product.

But by using AI tools to speed its work, Unconventional AI already has developed its first test chip and is nearing completion of its second, prompting the company to look for an engineering team with experience delivering finished products, Rao said.
Founded in 2019 by Moshe Tanach, formerly of Marvell Technology and Intel, Tzvika Shmueli and Yossi Kasus, NeuReality had already developed several advanced AI chips.
"Things have gone a lot faster than anticipated," Rao told Reuters. "We need people who can go execute and build products and scale them. We built up the research bones and now we've got to build up the production bones." 
Rao, who served on NeuReality's board, said about 40 people will join Unconventional AI as part of the deal, and that Unconventional AI will maintain a presence in Israel.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 'No fuel to keep babies warm': shortages push hospitals in Yemen's Taiz to brink
items.author: Olivia Le Poidevin
items.creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
items.summary: Fuel shortages in Yemen's besieged city of Taiz have forced one hospital to cut the number of incubators it can operate from 40 to 10, putting newborn babies at risk as weeks of fighting choke off vital supplies and deepen a humanitarian crisis affecting hundreds of thousands of people.
items.body:
Fuel shortages in Yemen's besieged city of [USN:L8N46125M TEXT:"Taiz"] have forced one hospital to cut the number of incubators it can operate from 40 to 10, putting newborn babies at risk as weeks of fighting choke off vital supplies and deepen a humanitarian crisis affecting hundreds of thousands of people.
"There's no oxygen, there's no fuel to run the incubators, to keep the babies warm," said Nada Ahmed, a nurse in the neonatal unit of the Yemeni-Swedish Hospital for Maternity and Childhood.
Nawal Najeeb, a supervisor in the neonatal unit, warned the facility could be forced to halt operations if fuel supplies do not arrive.
"It will be a catastrophe for the babies, a catastrophe of deaths and disabilities."
Taiz has been largely isolated since October 3, with fighting[USN:L6N4670EA TEXT:" preventing humanitarian supplies"] from entering and civilians from leaving, following an escalation in clashes between the Saudi-backed government and the Iran-aligned Houthi movement.
FUEL PRICES SURGE Key supply routes, including the Taiz-Aden corridor, have been blocked by Houthi forces, worsening shortages of water, food and fuel. The city hosts nearly half of the 250,000 people displaced by the latest fighting, according to the United Nations.
In Taiz city, 42 health facilities are reporting acute shortages of fuel, oxygen, medicines and medical supplies, WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said.
Fuel prices have surged to 2,000 Yemeni rials per litre, driver Abdullah al-Radfani told Reuters.
Oxfam Yemen's policy, advocacy and media manager, Fatma Jaffar Shotah, described one dialysis patient who has to spend two nights at a healthcare centre rather than travelling home between sessions because regular journeys have become unaffordable, the cost rising from half a dollar to around $10.
"Fuel shortage inside the city is having catastrophic impacts on people's lives," she said.
The strain is being felt beyond Taiz. Aid group Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said fuel shortages were causing power outages at hospitals and primary healthcare centres in the southern governorates of Aden and Lahj, affecting operating theatres and intensive care units.
HUNGER AND MALNUTRITION UN agencies and aid groups also warned of worsening hunger and malnutrition. The World Food Programme says that more than 800,000 people have been cut off from food assistance in Taiz and surrounding areas.
UNICEF spokesperson Ricardo Pires said 52,000 of the 168,000 children screened in Taiz so far this year are acutely malnourished, including more than 11,500 suffering from severe acute malnutrition.
Although UNICEF has put in place nearly 8,000 cartons of life-saving therapeutic food, enough to sustain treatment services for around three months, Pires warned that worsening insecurity and movement restrictions could hamper future deliveries and prevent families from reaching treatment centres.
MSF said growing displacement was aggravating child malnutrition in southern Yemen, an area which has already faced a long-standing hunger crisis, as families flee fighting in the north and along the west coast.
Between September 15 and October 22, MSF screened 299 children under 5 at its mobile clinics in Aden and Lahj. Forty-four children, or 14.7%, were suffering from moderate acute malnutrition, while 28 children, or 9.4%, were severely malnourished and in need of hospital care.
"In each location we go, on a daily basis, we see at least one or two children who are in severe acute malnutrition," said MSF's mobile health activity manager, Sara Ghanem.

A pigeon flies past a Likud Party campaign billboard featuring US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Tel Aviv, Israel, Oct 26, 2026. (Photo: AP/Oded Balilty)

FAST

JERUSALEM: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu boasted of his endorsement from Donald Trump on the eve of Israel's election, suggesting the two leaders could restart their war against Iran if he wins, after Trump said they should "finish the job".
"US President Donald Trump has come with a friendship that has never existed before between an Israeli prime minister and an American president. And it is doubtful we will ever have such a friendly president again," Netanyahu said in a televised appearance late on Sunday (Oct 25) night. "He has another two years, and he says he is calling on you to vote for me."
In his own social media post on Sunday, Trump, who launched the Iran war jointly with Netanyahu in February, said: "Vote for Bibi Netanyahu for Prime Minister, we have to finish the job that we started!"
Netanyahu said Trump was willing to take action "that would finally, finally, remove the Iranian threat", but only as long as Netanyahu himself remains in power.

"And I have already instructed the Mossad and the IDF to bring down this regime, to bring down this regime because that is the only way to put an end to this threat," Netanyahu said, referring to Israel's main intelligence service and military.
Asked for comment on Netanyahu 's remarks, White House Deputy Press Secretary Anna Kelly said: “As President Trump stated, Iran is in very bad condition, both economically and militarily, and the blockade will remain in full force and effect, with oil flowing in record numbers of barrels through the Hormuz Strait."
"The United States will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the midterm elections," Kelly added via email, referring to the Nov 3 vote in the US.
Netanyahu's leading opponent, centrist former military Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot, posted his own comments on social media, praising Trump as "a true friend of Israel".
"I value his efforts and his commitment to Israel’s security, and I am confident that he will work in full cooperation with any leader chosen by the people."

Also read:

Billionaire Trump backer says Ben-Gvir, Smotrich should not serve in next Israeli government

Netanyahu says 'toppling' Iran government only way to end threat

EISENKOT ACCUSES NETANYAHU OF FEAR-MONGERING Tuesday's vote, Israel's first since the Oct 7, 2023, Hamas attacks, is the first chance for voters to deliver a verdict on the worst security failure in generations and the wars on multiple fronts that followed.
With Netanyahu already at the helm of the most right-wing government in Israeli history, politics have shifted even further to the right. Nearly all Jewish-led parties, including that of the hawkish Eisenkot, now oppose the "two-state solution" that underpinned decades of peace negotiations with the Palestinians.
But many voters say the divisive politics of Israel's longest-serving leader make the country weaker. Polls suggest Netanyahu's Likud Party will lose seats, potentially depriving his coalition of right-wing, far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties of its narrow majority.
Eisenkot and an array of opposition parties ranging from the rump of the centre-left to the right, also have no clear path to unseat him.
Netanyahu, 77, is an unrivalled master of political survival: the only time since 2009 that opponents managed to wrest him briefly from the premiership, it took four inconclusive elections within two years to get him out. He was back 18 months later.
Neither side planned major public events for Monday. But both posted on social media, drumming on the election's major themes — for Netanyahu, that he is the only leader with the mettle to face down Israel's enemies; for his opponents, that his divisive politics have weakened the country.
Netanyahu shared an AI-generated video on Monday of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, whose father Ali Khamenei was killed on the first night of US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February. Lying in a hospital bed, the younger Khamenei says his own vote would be "definitely not Bibi. Another term like this and I will be meeting my father sooner than expected".
On Sunday, Netanyahu posted a computer-generated photo of a mushroom cloud over Tel Aviv, saying Israel was in existential danger from Iran.
Eisenkot responded by accusing him of "relying on a campaign of fear-mongering, lies, and threats — including images of nuclear bombs in the heart of Tel Aviv. This time, it won’t work for him."
Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu carries its own political risks a week before a legislative election in which his own Republicans are seeking to hold onto power.
The Iran war is deeply unpopular in the United States, blamed for a surge in prices, especially for fuel. Major fighting has been suspended for months after ceasefire negotiations held without Israeli participation.

Source: Reuters/fh

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業の株価が下落した。宇宙企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が、同業界は大幅な再編や倒産に直面する可能性があると発言したことを受け、ＡＩインフラ投資と収益創出の間に広がる格差への懸念が強まった。

午前の取引で一時、ネオクラウド企業のコアウィーブは１．６％下落。ネビウス・グループは４％、アプライド・デジタルは２％、それぞれ下落した。 

マスク氏は２５日、債務市場では「ＡＩデータセンター以外から多額の収入を得ていない企業は、資金調達の道をほぼ完全に閉ざされている」と指摘。このため、「ネオクラウド」企業の間で大規模な再編や経営破綻が起きると予測した上で、スペースＸがネオクラウド企業を買収することはないとし、「無意味だ」と述べた。

グレートヒル・キャピタル会長のトーマス・ヘイズ氏は「マスク氏は正しい。これらのプロジェクトを今後進めるための資金を賄うには、別の収益・利益源が必要になるだろう。資本コストが高すぎて魅力的なリターンを得ることは難しい」と語った。

コアウィーブの広報担当者はロイターへの電子メールで、同社は「差別化された技術」といった強みに支えられ、成長資金を調達する機会を引き続き見いだしていると述べた。

items.title: Wall Street cierra en alza ya que solicitud de OPI de Anthropic impulsa acciones de IA
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA).
items.body:
Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA).
Anthropic reveló pérdidas considerables y un crecimiento vertiginoso de los ingresos en su solicitud de salida a bolsa en Estados Unidos, en la que expuso su ambición de crear sistemas de inteligencia artificial capaces de transformar la economía mundial a pesar de los altos costos que conlleva el desarrollo de la tecnología.
El laboratorio de IA sigue adelante con sus planes de salida a bolsa a pesar de que el calendario de ofertas, que en otoño boreal solía estar repleto, se ha reducido, ya que la volatilidad del mercado ha llevado a las empresas a retrasar sus ofertas.
La presentación de Anthropic se produce en un momento en que los inversores analizan con mayor detenimiento el posible retorno de las inversiones masivas en IA, justo al inicio de una semana intensa. Entre los eventos clave destacan el comunicado de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal el miércoles, los datos sobre crecimiento económico e inflación el jueves, y una serie de informes de resultados corporativos.
Más de un tercio de las empresas que integran el índice S&P 500 tienen previsto presentar sus resultados esta semana, incluidas las grandes compañías tecnológicas Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) . Sus cifras serán examinadas minuciosamente en busca de señales que indiquen si las cuantiosas inversiones en IA se están traduciendo efectivamente en crecimiento.
Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 53,35 puntos, O un 0,70%, a 7.677,03 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 214,02 puntos, o un 0,83%, a 26.169,38 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 146,60 puntos, o un 0,28%, a 52.361,76 unidades.
Las firmas de semiconductores y chips, consideradas por muchos como algunas de las grandes beneficiadas del auge de la IA, contribuyeron a impulsar las subidas. El índice general de chips de Filadelfia (.SOX) escaló cera de un 3% en la sesión, aunque acumula una baja del 12% en el mes.
Meta anunció el lunes que tiene previsto conseguir 95.000 millones de dólares de capital para financiar centros de datos, capacidad de computación en la nube y otras infraestructuras.

PARIS, Oct 26 : Geoffroy Roux de Bezieux is expected to be named president of the organising committee for the 2030 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games (OCOG) in the French Alps, a person familiar with the discussions told Reuters on Monday.
Roux de Bezieux, the former boss of France's main business lobby MEDEF, is expected to be appointed at the organising committee's executive board meeting on Thursday.
He would succeed Edgar Grospiron, who left the post last month before chief executive Vincent Roberti was appointed interim president.
Roux de Bezieux, 64, had been named chair of OCOG's Remuneration Committee in April.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Mercados argentinos se derrumban tras resultado electoral en Brasil
items.author: Hernan Nessi, Jorge Otaola
items.creator: Hernan Nessi, Jorge Otaola
items.summary: La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado triunfo del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo.
items.body:
La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado [USN:L2N46C00P TEXT:"triunfo"] del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo.
La mayoría de los analistas y operadores de Argentina daban por descontada una victoria del libertario Flávio Bolsonaro, afín ideológicamente al mandatario argentino Javier Milei.
El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa porteña cayó un fuerte 2,91% al cierre, luego de derrumbarse más del 6% en la primera parte operativa, mientras que su par brasileño Bovespa (.BVSP) llegó a hundirme [USN:L2N46C0JZ TEXT:"más de un 17%."]
La devaluación del real, moneda de Brasil, tiende a complicar la competitividad de la propia economía argentina.
"El sorprendente resultado electoral no solo es una mala noticia para el mercado brasileño. El efecto contagio también afecta al Merval y bonos soberanos argentinos", expresó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.
"Por el lado macro, un real más débil pone presión al dólar al apreciar el tipo de cambio real multilateral", agregó.
Al respecto, el peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,75% a 1.541 por dólar, tras tocar un mínimo histórico intradiario de 1.542 unidades para la venta, y los bonos en la ronda extrabursátil retrocedieron en promedio un 0,6%.
El banco central (BCRA) no contabilizó intervención cambiaria, como se preveía, ante reservas provisorias en 50.481 millones de dólares.
El riesgo país argentino saltaba a los 755 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), un nivel similar al registrado a fines de octubre del 2025.
"Brasil se encamina a una dura jornada financiera (... con) marcada debilidad en la renta fija y una fuerte depreciación del real. Los mercados deberán desarmar las expectativas generadas por un posible triunfo de Bolsonaro y absorber un nuevo 'cisne negro': un hecho poco probable, pero de gran impacto", dijo el economista Gustavo Ber.
"El contagio de dicho malhumor sobre los activos argentinos parece irreversible y que podría ser también importante (...) en un mundo que afrontará sucesivas elecciones relevantes en los próximos meses -entre ellas, en Israel, Estados Unidos y Francia-, la lección para los inversores vuelve a ser que todo pronóstico puede fallar", agregó.
Argentina celebrará comicios presidenciales en 2027, donde Milei buscará su reelección.

items.title: ネタニヤフ氏、総選挙控えトランプ氏の支持誇示　再選ならイラン戦争再開と示唆
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steven Scheer　Emily Rose

[エルサレム ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Steven Scheer　Emily Rose

[エルサレム ２６日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、総選挙を翌日に控え、トランプ米大統領からの支持を誇示した。また、トランプ氏が両首脳で「任務を完遂」すべきだと発言したことを受け、自身が勝利すればイランに対する戦争を再開するとの可能性を示唆した。

ネタニヤフ氏は２５日に出演したテレビ番組で「トランプ大統領は、イスラエルの首相と米大統領の間でかつてないほどの友好関係を築いてくれた。これほど友好的な大統領が再び現れることはまずないだろう」とし、トランプ大統領には「あと２年の任期があり、私に投票するよう皆さんに呼びかけている」と語った。

トランプ氏は２５日、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に「ビビ・ネタニヤフに投票してほしい。われわれは始めた任務を完遂しなければならない」と投稿した。トランプ氏は今年２月、ネタニヤフ氏とともにイランとの戦争に踏み切った。

ネタニヤフ氏は、トランプ氏が「イランの脅威をついに排除する」ための行動を取る用意があると述べたが、それはネタニヤフ氏自身が権力の座にとどまる場合に限ると指摘。「私はすでに（イスラエル情報機関 ）モサドと（イスラエル国防軍）ＩＤＦに対し、この政権を打倒するよう指示を出している。それがこの脅威に終止符を打つ唯一の方法だからだ」と述べた。

ネタニヤフ氏の発言についてコメントを求められたホワイトハウスのケリー副報道官は電子メールで、「トランプ大統領が述べた通り、イランは経済的にも軍事的にも非常に厳しい状況にあり、ホルムズ海峡の封鎖は引き続き全面的に効力を持つ」と指摘。その上で、米国が１１月３日の中間選挙前に「イランを攻撃することはない」と述べた。

２７日に実施されるイスラエル総選挙は、２０２３年１０月７日のイスラム組織ハマスによる攻撃以降初となり、有権者が数世代にわたる安全保障上の失敗と、それに続く複数の戦線での戦争について審判を下す最初の機会となる。

Oct 26 : French Open runner-up Maja Chwalinska has withdrawn from this week's Tokyo Open due to a thigh injury sustained at the Wuhan Open where she won her first WTA tour title.
Chwalinska beat Polish compatriot Iga Swiatek in the Wuhan semis this month before overcoming Sonay Kartal in the final.
"I travelled to Tokyo early for physiotherapy and on-court practice, doing everything possible to recover in time, but unfortunately, I am still not ready to compete," Chwalinska posted on Instagram on Monday.
The Tokyo Open started on Monday.

items.title: Anthropic IPO: Rising costs, risks, rapid growth mark AI frontrunner
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Anthropic, established by ex OpenAI researchers, is gearing up for an anticipated entry into the stock market in the United States. The organization has impressively generated $16.29 billion in revenue during the first half of 2026. Yet, significant operational losses due to soaring computing costs pose a challenge, along with over $500 billion in cloud computing commitments. Competing against OpenAI and Google, they must adeptly maneuver through a tough economic environment.
items.body: Anthropic’s US IPO filing puts a fresh spotlight on the high cost of staying ahead in artificial intelligence, with the Claude maker showing explosive revenue growth while taking on enormous spending commitments and widening losses, according to Reuters.The company unveiled its IPO paperwork on Monday after confidentially filing in June.Revenue surges, but losses remain steepFounded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers Dario and Daniela Amodei, Anthropic has built a strong position in the AI race through its Claude models, particularly in coding and enterprise applications.The company's revenue surged to $4.59 billion in 2025 from $386 million in 2024 and $41 million in 2023. It then more than tripled to $16.29 billion in the first six months of 2026. But the rapid expansion is proving expensive. Anthropic recorded an operating loss of $693 million in the first half of 2026, after losing $8.06 billion in 2025, compared with $2.98 billion a year earlier, Reuters reported.Compute race comes with billion dollar commitmentsComputing power is at the heart of Anthropic’s cost structure, with the company spending on cloud services, data centres, equipment leases and energy.It has committed more than $500 billion with six partners over a decade, including at least $110 billion with Amazon, about $114.5 billion with Google and $44.9 billion with Microsoft for cloud computing over the next seven to 10 years.That spending also reflects the increasingly interconnected nature of AI financing. Amazon and Google are among Anthropic’s biggest backers. Amazon has invested at least $13 billion and agreed to invest up to another $20 billion, while Google has committed up to $40 billion.Anthropic will retain a governance structure that gives its founders significant control after the listing. As a public benefit corporation, it is also required to balance investor interests with its broader mission of developing AI for the benefit of humanity.Competition is intensifying as OpenAI, Google and Elon Musk’s SpaceX pour billions into models, data centres and specialised chips. Ramp data showed Anthropic accounted for 60.1% of AI token spending in the week ended October 11, highlighting the momentum behind Claude as the IPO brings its spending model under greater investor scrutiny, Reuters reported.
